01998b2912fd227f.zh: 時間「오후에」在先，接主語「비가」，再以句型「올지도 모르니까」連接後句。
01998b2912fd227f.en: Time 오후에 precedes subject 비가, followed by the pattern 올지도 모르니까 introducing the reason.

04afb32a1c107f3d.en: When a noun is used with 위해(서), it takes the object particle 을/를.
04afb32a1c107f3d.zh: 名詞搭配「위해(서)」時，必須使用受格助詞「을/를」。

04afb32a1c107f3d.en: 이 is a subject particle; the pattern requires the object particle 을/를.
04afb32a1c107f3d.zh: 「이」為主格助詞，文法要求受格助詞「을/를 위해(서)」。

04afb32a1c107f3d.en: 의 is the possessive particle and does not fit the pattern N을/를 위해(서).
04afb32a1c107f3d.zh: 「의」為屬格「的」，不符合「N을/를 위해(서)」的固定用法。

04afb32a1c107f3d.en: 에 is a locative/directional particle and cannot precede 위해(서).
04afb32a1c107f3d.zh: 「에」為場所或時間助詞，不能接在「위해(서)」前面表示目的。

073dcbe9583e0682.en: 재미있을걸요 correctly expresses a casual guess about the movie being fun.
073dcbe9583e0682.zh: 形容詞「재미있다」接「-(으)ㄹ걸요」表示輕鬆推測，符合語境。

073dcbe9583e0682.en: 재미있을래요 is wrong because -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses intent and cannot be used with adjectives.
073dcbe9583e0682.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」表示說話者的意願或詢問意向，不能用於形容詞「재미있다」。

073dcbe9583e0682.en: 재미있자고요 is ungrammatical; the propositive form cannot attach to adjectives.
073dcbe9583e0682.zh: 「-자고 하다」用於提議共做某事，無法接在形容詞「재미있다」後表示推測。

073dcbe9583e0682.en: 재미있으세요 improperly applies the honorific imperative/statement ending to a movie.
073dcbe9583e0682.zh: 「-(으)세요」為命令或對聽者的尊稱，不能用於形容詞修飾電影的推測。

09bfef52233bae0b.zh: 「-아/어 오다」表示自過去持續至今，살다 規則結合為 살아。
09bfef52233bae0b.en: Correct. 살다 takes -아 to form 살아 왔어요, meaning having lived here up to now.

09bfef52233bae0b.zh: 「살고」不能接 왔어요 表達「一直生活過來」的持續歷程。
09bfef52233bae0b.en: -고 cannot attach to auxiliary 오다 to express action continuing up to the present.

09bfef52233bae0b.zh: 「사는」是現在修飾形，後續應接名詞，不能接動詞 왔어요。
09bfef52233bae0b.en: 사는 is a noun-modifying form and must precede a noun, not 왔어요.

09bfef52233bae0b.zh: 「살」是冠形詞形或詞幹，不能直接連接 왔어요。
09bfef52233bae0b.en: 살 is a bare stem or future noun-modifier, unsuitable before 왔어요.

0ade206748a312a4.zh: 正確。「-래요」是命令句「-(으)라고 해요」的口語縮略型。
0ade206748a312a4.en: Correct. 오래요 is the casual contraction of the reported command 오라고 해요.

0ade206748a312a4.zh: 「온대요」是轉述陳述句，意思會變成「老師說他明天會早來」。
0ade206748a312a4.en: 온대요 reports a statement, meaning the teacher said they would come early.

0ade206748a312a4.zh: 「오재요」是轉述提議「-자고 해요」，意為「提議一起早點來」。
0ade206748a312a4.en: 오재요 reports a suggestion to come together, not a direct instruction.

0ade206748a312a4.zh: 「오냬요」是轉述疑問「-냐고 해요」，意思會變成問對方是否早來。
0ade206748a312a4.en: 오냬요 reports a question, meaning asking whether someone comes early.

0bcc1bfacd828865.zh: 形容詞過去推測為「-았/었을 텐데」，故用「피곤했을」。
0bcc1bfacd828865.en: For a past supposition with adjectives, use -았/었을 텐데, giving 피곤했을.
피곤할었을 is an incorrect combination of tense suffixes.

0bcc1bfacd828865.zh: 「피곤한」為形容詞現在冠形詞形，無法表達過去推測。
0bcc1bfacd828865.en: 피곤한 is the present modifier form and misses the past guess meaning.

0bcc1bfacd828865.zh: 「피곤해서」表示原因，無法直接接依賴名詞「텐데」。
0bcc1bfacd828865.en: 피곤해서 is a connective clause ending and cannot modify 텐데.

0f00c7fea57d4569.zh: 「-는 길에」表示在…途中的慣用句型，接時間助詞 에。
0f00c7fea57d4569.en: 길에 completes the fixed expression -는 길에, meaning on the way to.

0f00c7fea57d4569.zh: 「길을」使用了受格助詞 을，無法表示在…途中的時間點。
0f00c7fea57d4569.en: 길을 uses the object particle 을, which cannot indicate a time or occasion like on the way.

0f00c7fea57d4569.zh: 「길이」使用了主格助詞 이，無法形成在…途中的副詞修飾。
0f00c7fea57d4569.en: 길이 uses the subject particle 이, which cannot mean on the way to.

0f00c7fea57d4569.zh: 「길만」表示「只有路」，語意不通且不符慣用語法。
0f00c7fea57d4569.en: 길만 means only the way, which does not fit the pattern on the way to.

11076e7fedcae600.zh: 時間「어릴 때」接頻率「자주」，修飾過去習慣的「먹던」接名詞「음식이」。
11076e7fedcae600.en: Time phrase 어릴 때 and adverb 자주 lead into past habitual modifier 먹던 modifying 음식이.

11a3d975a3f49d27.zh: 「-더라고요」接在形容詞詞幹後，表示分享自己親身經歷感受到的事實。
11a3d975a3f49d27.en: Attach -더라고요 to the adjective stem to share what you observed or experienced first-hand.

11a3d975a3f49d27.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」只能用於第一人稱動詞表示承諾或意志，不能接形容詞。
11a3d975a3f49d27.en: The ending -(으)ㄹ게요 only attaches to verbs with a first-person subject, not adjectives.

11a3d975a3f49d27.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」用於表達說話者意向或詢問對方意願，不能接形容詞。
11a3d975a3f49d27.en: The ending -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses intention or asks someone's preference, not for adjectives describing scenes.

11a3d975a3f49d27.zh: 「-자고요」是提議的間接引語形式，不能用於形容詞描述海景。
11a3d975a3f49d27.en: The ending -자고요 is a quotative suggestion form and cannot be used with adjectives.

125f97bef2427bc6.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 만하다」表值得或尚可，有收音接「읽을」。
125f97bef2427bc6.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ 만하다 requires -(으)ㄹ, attaching 읽을 to stems with a final consonant.
The form -는 is the present modifier and cannot precede 만하다.
The modifier -은 marks past tense and cannot be followed by 만하다.
The infinitive ending 읽어 cannot directly attach to 만해요.

1304844eb2ee673e.zh: 「-아/어 두다」需接動詞語幹的連用形，「올리다」變化為「올려」。
1304844eb2ee673e.en: -아/어 두다 requires the -아/어 form of the verb, which for 올리다 is 올려.

1304844eb2ee673e.zh: 「-고」不能與補助動詞「두다」結合成「做好並保持」的句型。
1304844eb2ee673e.en: -고 cannot combine with auxiliary verb 두다 to express leaving something done.

1304844eb2ee673e.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」是修飾未來名詞的冠形詞尾，不能接「두었어요」。
1304844eb2ee673e.en: -(으)ㄹ is an adnominal suffix modifying future nouns and cannot attach to 두었어요.

1304844eb2ee673e.zh: 「-게」是副詞形詞尾，不能接補助動詞「두다」。
1304844eb2ee673e.en: -게 forms an adverbial clause and cannot be followed by auxiliary verb 두다.

144df569885519d3.zh: 「-도록」表示為了達到後續結果的目的，意為「以便…」。
144df569885519d3.en: 도록 attaches to 있- to mean so that or in order for students to understand.

144df569885519d3.zh: 「-(으)려고」前後主詞必須相同，此句前後主詞不同且有補助動詞。
144df569885519d3.en: 으려고 requires the same subject in both clauses and cannot follow -을 수 있다.

144df569885519d3.zh: 「-자마자」表示「一…就…」，不符合「為了能理解而說明」的語意。
144df569885519d3.en: 자마자 means as soon as, which does not fit the intended meaning.

144df569885519d3.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中斷轉換，無法表達說明的目的。
144df569885519d3.en: 다가 indicates an interrupted action and does not express purpose.

152898e9c613a67b.zh: 正解。動詞幹接 -느라고 表示因忙於某事而產生不良後果。
152898e9c613a67b.en: Correct. Verb stem attaches -느라고 to show that spending time/effort led to a negative result.

152898e9c613a67b.zh: 錯誤形式。韓語中沒有 -느라서 這種文法連接詞尾。
152898e9c613a67b.en: Incorrect form. The ending -느라서 does not exist in Korean grammar.

152898e9c613a67b.zh: -느라고 前不可加上過去式詞尾 -았/었-，應接原形詞幹。
152898e9c613a67b.en: The past tense -았/었- cannot be used before -느라고; use the basic stem.

152898e9c613a67b.zh: 意為「為了搬家」，表示目的，與後句「沒有心思」不搭配。
152898e9c613a67b.en: Means in order to move; expresses intention/purpose, which doesn't fit the negative result.

158bbbb17d296d3e.zh: 固定文法為名詞加上「에 비해(서)」，表示「與……相比」。
158bbbb17d296d3e.en: The standard grammatical pattern is N에 비해(서), meaning compared with the price.

158bbbb17d296d3e.zh: 「비하다」在此固定接副詞格助詞「-에」，不能接受格助詞「-을」。
158bbbb17d296d3e.en: The pattern requires the particle 에 with the comparison base, not the object marker 을.

158bbbb17d296d3e.zh: 「보다」和「에 비해」皆表比較，不可重複疊用成「보다 비해」。
158bbbb17d296d3e.en: 보다 and 에 비해 both express comparison and cannot be combined into 보다 비해.

158bbbb17d296d3e.zh: 慣用語固定為「에 비해(서)」，不可使用並列連接詞尾「-고」。
158bbbb17d296d3e.en: The established comparative phrase uses the -아/어 form 비해(서), not the conjunctive -고.

164fbc1540e91be7.zh: 正確。轉述疑問句時接「-냐고 하다/물어보다」。
「-자고」用於轉述提議，無法與後面表達詢問的「물어봤어요」搭配。
164fbc1540e91be7.en: 있자고 reports a proposal, which does not fit asking a question with 물어봤어요.

164fbc1540e91be7.zh: 「-(으)라고」用於轉述命令或要求，不適用於詢問有沒有時間。
164fbc1540e91be7.en: 있으라고 reports a command to stay, not a question about time.

164fbc1540e91be7.zh: 「-다고」用於轉述陳述句，此處句子是詢問「什麼時候有空」。
164fbc1540e91be7.en: 있다고 reports a statement rather than an indirect question.

19aa2c595f080ffc.zh: 副詞「미리」修飾「말해 줬으면」，再接過去推測「좋았을」與「텐데요」。
19aa2c595f080ffc.en: Adverb 미리 modifies 말해 줬으면, which is followed by the past guess 좋았을 before 텐데요.

1a50cd408bf75fcb.zh: 受詞「옷을」接「샀다가」表示買完又退貨，接原因「마음에 안 들어서」與「환불했어요」。
1a50cd408bf75fcb.en: 옷을 pairs with 샀다가 to show buying then reversing it, followed by the reason 마음에 안 들어서 and predicate 환불했어요.

1a7890decb5b6396.zh: 主詞「민수 씨도」搭配副詞「아마」，受詞「그 사실을」置於謂語「알걸요」前。
1a7890decb5b6396.en: Subject 민수 씨도 comes first, followed by 아마 and object 그 사실을, ending with 알걸요.

1aba073c6f2ff7fb.zh: 動詞接「-기 위해서」表示目的，意為「為了進入好大學」。
1aba073c6f2ff7fb.en: 들어가기 위해서 correctly attaches -기 위해서 to 들어가다 to express purpose.

1aba073c6f2ff7fb.zh: 「위해서」前面必須接名詞形「-기」，不能接冠形詞「-는」。
1aba073c6f2ff7fb.en: 들어가는 위해서 is incorrect because 위해서 requires the nominalizer -기, not -는.

1aba073c6f2ff7fb.zh: 「-기 때문에」表示原因「因為進入」，與後面的努力學習語意不符。
1aba073c6f2ff7fb.en: 들어가기 때문에 means because I enter, which contradicts the context of studying.

1aba073c6f2ff7fb.zh: 「-도록」與「위해서」不能疊加使用，文法結構錯誤。
1aba073c6f2ff7fb.en: 들어가도록 위해서 ungrammatically combines both -도록 and 위해서.

1bb1ef6955fecf63.en: The stem 사- ends in a vowel, so it takes -려면 directly without adding -으-.
1bb1ef6955fecf63.zh: 動詞「사다」詞幹無收音，直接接「-려면」。

1bb1ef6955fecf63.en: The verb stem of 사다 is 사-, not a ㄹ-irregular stem, so 살- is incorrect.
1bb1ef6955fecf63.zh: 只有「ㄹ」收音的動詞或形態變化才會有「살-」，「사다」不能隨意加「ㄹ」。

1bb1ef6955fecf63.en: -으- is only inserted after consonants; 사으려면 is an incorrect form.
1bb1ef6955fecf63.zh: 無收音詞幹不能插入介音「-으-」，「사으려면」為錯誤拼法。

1bb1ef6955fecf63.en: Past tense markers like -았- cannot be attached before -(으)려면.
1bb1ef6955fecf63.zh: 假設意圖條件「-(으)려면」前不能添加過去式「-았-」。

1bd9e6b8bf8ba797.en: 보이다 is the passive form of 보다, used when something is visible.
1bd9e6b8bf8ba797.zh: 「보다」的被動形為「보이다」，表示首爾塔被看見或看得見。

1bd9e6b8bf8ba797.en: 봐요 is active (look/watch) and takes an object with 을/를, not 이/가.
1bd9e6b8bf8ba797.zh: 「봐요」為主動形，主詞應是觀看者，受詞才接塔。

1bd9e6b8bf8ba797.en: 보혀요 is incorrect; 보다 takes the passive suffix -이-, not -히-.
보려요 is incorrect; 보다 takes the passive suffix -이-, not -리-.

1c037f31210f01f1.en: 마시던 expresses an unfinished past action, matching coffee left half-drunk.
1c037f31210f01f1.zh: 「마시던」表示過去喝到一半、尚未喝完的動作，符合句意。

1c037f31210f01f1.en: 마신 indicates completed action, implying you already finished the coffee.
1c037f31210f01f1.zh: 「마신」表示動作已完全結束，聽起來像咖啡已經喝完了。

1c037f31210f01f1.en: 마실 is the future modifier meaning coffee to be drank later.
1c037f31210f01f1.zh: 「마실」是將來式定語，表示「打算喝的」，與過去找咖啡不符。

1c037f31210f01f1.en: 마시는다 is an ungrammatical combination and cannot modify nouns.
1c037f31210f01f1.zh: 「마시는다」是不合文法的錯誤形式，不能修飾名詞。

1ec36518c77af339.zh: 「늦을 뻔했어요」符合「-(으)ㄹ 뻔하다」過去式，表示差點遲到。
1ec36518c77af339.en: Correct. 늦을 뻔했어요 properly uses -(으)ㄹ 뻔하다 in the past tense for nearly being late.

1ec36518c77af339.zh: 「늦은 뻔했어요」誤用了過去修飾形 -은，應使用 -(으)ㄹ。
1ec36518c77af339.en: 늦은 incorrectly uses -은; the structure requires the future form -(으)ㄹ.

1ec36518c77af339.zh: 「늦을 뻔해요」為現在式，此句型陳述已避開的過去事件需用過去式。
1ec36518c77af339.en: 뻔하다 must almost always be conjugated into the past tense (뻔했다) for past near-misses.

1ec36518c77af339.zh: 「-을래요」表示意願或打算，不能加在 뻔했다 後面表達差點發生的事。
1ec36518c77af339.en: -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses intent or willingness, which is nonsensical with 뻔하다.

1ee10403d4d990bd.zh: 「되어」符合「-아/어 가다」句型，表示飯快要煮好了。
1ee10403d4d990bd.en: Correct. 되다 takes -어 to form 되어 가요, meaning the cooking is nearly finished.

1ee10403d4d990bd.zh: 「되고」表順序或並列，不能與 가요 結合表達快要完成。
1ee10403d4d990bd.en: 되고 links actions with 'and' and cannot combine with 가요 to mean nearly done.

1ee10403d4d990bd.zh: 「될」是將來修飾形，不能直接接補助動詞 가요。
1ee10403d4d990bd.en: 될 is a noun-modifying future form, not the sequential link to 가요.
됐어 is an informal past tense form and cannot grammatically connect to 가요.

1f8a0205aa7e35d2.zh: 形容詞「괜찮다」有收音，修飾名詞「척」接「-은」成為「괜찮은」
1f8a0205aa7e35d2.en: Adjective 괜찮다 has a final consonant, so it takes -은 to modify 척.

1f8a0205aa7e35d2.zh: 形容詞現在式不能接動詞用的定語詞尾「-는」
1f8a0205aa7e35d2.en: -는 is used for verbs in the present tense, not for adjectives like 괜찮다.

1f8a0205aa7e35d2.zh: 「괜찮을」為未來或推測定語形，不符合此處表達當下假裝狀態
1f8a0205aa7e35d2.en: 괜찮을 is a prospective/future modifier form, which does not fit here.

1f8a0205aa7e35d2.zh: 「척하다」前必須是定語形，不能接非格式體語尾「괜찮아」
1f8a0205aa7e35d2.en: 괜찮아 is an informal sentence ending, not a noun modifier needed by 척.

1ffde718d10143e5.zh: 「되어 가요」表示時間快要到了、逐漸接近滿一年。
1ffde718d10143e5.en: Correct. 되어 가다 indicates approaching a certain state or time (nearly reaching a year).

1ffde718d10143e5.zh: 「있어요」前面通常接 -고 表示進行，不與 -어 連用表示接近。
1ffde718d10143e5.en: -어 있어요 expresses a remaining state, not an action/time nearing completion.

1ffde718d10143e5.zh: 「줘요」表示為某人做某事，語意與時間經過完全不符。
1ffde718d10143e5.en: -어 주다 means doing something for someone, which does not make sense here.

1ffde718d10143e5.zh: 「봐요」表示嘗試做某事，不符合時間即將屆滿的語境。
1ffde718d10143e5.en: -어 보다 means trying something out, which does not fit time passing.

20ca5486d5cca4a5.en: The pattern -도록 attaches directly to the verb stem to express in order that or so that.
20ca5486d5cca4a5.zh: 「-도록」表示目的「為了使…」，接詞幹後表示為了聽得清楚。

20ca5486d5cca4a5.en: Past tense markers like -았/었- are not used before -도록.
-(으)려고 implies agent intention and cannot be followed by an imperative or request.
20ca5486d5cca4a5.zh: 「-(으)려고」主詞須具意圖，且後句不能接命令句或請託句。

20ca5486d5cca4a5.en: -자마자 means as soon as, which does not convey purpose or result.
20ca5486d5cca4a5.zh: 「-자마자」表示「一…就…」，不符合「為了能聽見」的意思。

226c3617685a1aa0.zh: 「있다」屬於存在詞，依文法規則須接動詞形式「-나 보다」
226c3617685a1aa0.en: The existential verb 있다 consistently takes the verb pattern -나 보다.

226c3617685a1aa0.zh: 「있다」不接形容詞形式「-(으)ㄴ가 보다」，無「있은가」形態
226c3617685a1aa0.en: 있다 does not use the adjective pattern -(으)ㄴ가 보다; 있은가 is incorrect.

226c3617685a1aa0.zh: 重複疊加了詞尾「-는가」與「-나」，韓文中沒有這種組合
226c3617685a1aa0.en: 있는가나 mistakenly combines two endings (-는가 and -나) together.

226c3617685a1aa0.zh: 推測句型直接在語幹後接「-나 보다」，不可接「-어나」
226c3617685a1aa0.en: The pattern -나 보다 attaches straight to the verb stem, not via -어.

22a367026b2dc317.en: -(으)려면 means if you want to and is naturally followed by requirements with -아/어야 하다.
22a367026b2dc317.zh: 「-(으)려면」表示「若想要做某事」，後句常接必須條件「-아/어야 하다」。

22a367026b2dc317.en: -(으)려고 describes an intention for a past/present action, not a hypothetical condition.
22a367026b2dc317.zh: 「-(으)려고」後句通常是具體行動，不常直接接「-아/어야 하다」。

22a367026b2dc317.en: -다가 indicates an action interrupted by another event, not a conditional goal.
22a367026b2dc317.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中途轉換，不符合「為了學好韓語必須每天練習」。

22a367026b2dc317.en: -거나 means or, which does not fit establishing a prerequisite condition.
22a367026b2dc317.zh: 「-거나」表示「或者」，無法表達條件與要求。

2399a63f0c419c3c.zh: 正解。形容詞 피곤하다 的 -아/어 形式為 피곤해，接 보이다。
2399a63f0c419c3c.en: Correct. 피곤하다 conjugates to 피곤해 before the auxiliary verb 보이다.

2399a63f0c419c3c.zh: 詞幹未轉換成 -아/어 形態，不能直接接 보이다。
2399a63f0c419c3c.en: The bare stem cannot directly attach to 보이다 without the -아/어 connector.

2399a63f0c419c3c.zh: 這是修飾名詞的冠形詞形，後面不能直接接動詞 보이다。
2399a63f0c419c3c.en: This is the noun-modifying adjective form, which cannot directly precede 보이다.

2399a63f0c419c3c.zh: 這是表示原因的連接詞尾，不能與 보이다 結合成「看起來」的句型。
2399a63f0c419c3c.en: This is a causal connective ending, not the pattern -아/어 보이다.

2581e356b859fbbb.zh: 前句「친구가 부르는데」提供背景，動詞「자다」接「-는 척했어요」表示假裝睡覺
2581e356b859fbbb.en: 친구가 부르는데 sets background context, followed by verb 자다 with -는 척했어요.

26fcd2b4891ddc84.zh: 「-아/어 가다」表示接近完成，끝나다 結合為 끝나 가요。
26fcd2b4891ddc84.en: Correct. -아/어 가다 expresses an action nearing completion, here formed as 끝나 가요.

26fcd2b4891ddc84.zh: 「끝나고」是表並列或順序的連接詞尾，不能與 가요 連用。
26fcd2b4891ddc84.en: -고 expresses listing or sequence and cannot directly combine with 가요 in this structure.

26fcd2b4891ddc84.zh: 「끝날」是未來修飾形，不能直接接補助動詞 가요。
26fcd2b4891ddc84.en: -ㄹ is the future noun-modifying ending and cannot directly connect to auxiliary verb 가요.

26fcd2b4891ddc84.zh: 「끝났어」是過去式非敬語，文法上無法直接接 가요。
26fcd2b4891ddc84.en: 끝났어 is an informal past tense form and cannot attach directly to 가요.

270c3f4412c6f977.zh: 主詞「의사가」後接賓語「술을」，禁止命令「마시지 말라고」修飾後續的「했어요」。
270c3f4412c6f977.en: Subject 의사가 takes object 술을, followed by the negative reported command 마시지 말라고 before 했어요.

2a158382c09f7eda.zh: 「-다가」表示進行看電視的動作中途中斷，轉而發生接電話。
2a158382c09f7eda.en: 다가 correctly indicates that the action of watching TV was interrupted by the phone ringing.

2a158382c09f7eda.zh: 「-도록」表示目的或程度「為了…、做到…」，語義不合。
2a158382c09f7eda.en: 도록 expresses purpose or extent (so that / to the point of), which does not make sense here.

2a158382c09f7eda.zh: 「-러」表示移動的目的「去為了看」，需接移動動詞。
2a158382c09f7eda.en: 러 indicates the purpose of moving (in order to see) and must be followed by a movement verb.

2a158382c09f7eda.zh: 「-려면」是「想要看的話」的意圖假設，與後文接電話不合。
2a158382c09f7eda.en: 려면 means if one intends to watch, which does not fit an ongoing interrupted event.

2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.zh: 語幹以 ㄹ 結尾的「알다」直接接 지도，成為「알지도」。
2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.en: For stems ending in ㄹ like 알다, add 지도 directly to form 알지도.

2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.zh: 「알다」語幹為 ㄹ，不能重複添加 을，故型態錯誤。
2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.en: Stems ending in ㄹ do not take 을; 알을지도 is incorrect.

2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.zh: 推測現在知道的狀態時，應用原型接「-(으)ㄹ지도」。
2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.en: For a present guess about knowing, use 알지도 rather than past 알았지도.

2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.zh: 「-게」是副詞形或使動結尾，不能接「-지도 모르다」。
2bfdd6b1d65be6cc.en: -게 turns verbs into adverbs and does not attach to -지도 모르다.

2c331341f6a8b0ee.zh: 「-지 않으면 안 되다」為雙重否定句型，表示「必須」。
2c331341f6a8b0ee.en: The pattern -지 않으면 안 되다 is a double negative meaning must.

2c331341f6a8b0ee.zh: 此句型固定搭配「안 되다」，不能用「못 돼요」。
2c331341f6a8b0ee.en: This pattern requires 안 되다, so 못 돼요 cannot be used.

2c331341f6a8b0ee.zh: 句型固定為「-지 않으면 안 되다」，不可使用「하다」。
2c331341f6a8b0ee.en: The grammar rule requires 되다 rather than 하다.

2c331341f6a8b0ee.zh: 句型固定搭配「되다」，不能替換為「있다」。
2c331341f6a8b0ee.en: The fixed construction uses 되다, not 있다.

2e22c98097d735f1.zh: 正確。「-던」用於修飾名詞，表示過去經常重複或持續的動作、習慣。
2e22c98097d735f1.en: Correct. -던 modifies nouns to express a past routine or repeated action.

2e22c98097d735f1.zh: 「-는」是現在式冠形詞詞尾，表示目前正在使用的包包。
2e22c98097d735f1.en: 쓰는 is the present modifier, describing a bag currently in use.

2e22c98097d735f1.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」是未來式或推測冠形詞詞尾，表示打算要用的包包。
2e22c98097d735f1.en: 쓸 is the future/prospective modifier, meaning a bag to be used.

2e22c98097d735f1.zh: 「쓴다」是終結詞尾，無法直接置於名詞「가방」前修飾它。
2e22c98097d735f1.en: 쓴다 is a final declarative verb form, so it cannot modify 가방.

3057051b394a4d7f.zh: 主語「저는」後接賓語「매운 음식을」，最後接說明原因的否定動詞「못 먹거든요」。
3057051b394a4d7f.en: Subject 저는 is followed by object 매운 음식을, finishing with the explanatory negative verb 못 먹거든요.

3182c7d87ba08c4c.zh: 說話者「선생님이」在前，引述內容「내일 시험이 있다고」接敬語引述「하셨어요」。
3182c7d87ba08c4c.en: Speaker 선생님이 comes first, followed by the quoted clause 내일 시험이 있다고 and verb 하셨어요.

3290cf2e6989e06b.en: Reported questions use -냐고 with verbs like 묻다; 하다 becomes 하냐고.
3290cf2e6989e06b.zh: 轉述疑問句（朋友問「做什麼？」）接「-냐고 하다/묻다」，故選「하냐고」。

3290cf2e6989e06b.en: 하자고 reports a proposal and cannot be followed by 물었어요 (asked).
3290cf2e6989e06b.zh: 「하자고」是轉述提議句，不能與後面的「물었어요（詢問）」搭配。

3290cf2e6989e06b.en: 하라고 reports a command and does not match the verb 물었어요 (asked).
3290cf2e6989e06b.zh: 「하라고」是轉述命令句，不能與後面的「물었어요（詢問）」搭配。

3290cf2e6989e06b.en: 한다고 reports a statement, which does not match the reporting verb 물었어요.
3290cf2e6989e06b.zh: 「한다고」是轉述陳述句，不能與後面的「물었어요（詢問）」搭配。

32bddf255a1974a0.zh: 主詞「두 사람이」後接副詞「요즘」，動詞「사귀다」接「-나 봐요」作推測
32bddf255a1974a0.en: Subject 두 사람이 is modified by 요즘, then verb 사귀다 takes -나 봐요.

32d38edff2acd8be.en: Correct. 피곤하다 ends in a vowel, attaching -(으)ㄹ 텐데 to become 피곤할 텐데.
32d38edff2acd8be.zh: 正確。形容詞 피곤하다 無收音，接 -(으)ㄹ 텐데 成為 피곤할 텐데。

32d38edff2acd8be.en: 피곤한 is the adjective modifier form and cannot precede 텐데.
32d38edff2acd8be.zh: 「피곤한」是修飾名詞的冠形詞形，無法搭配 텐데（터+이+ㄴ데）。

32d38edff2acd8be.en: 피곤하는 is grammatically incorrect since adjectives cannot take -는.
피곤해 is an informal connective form and cannot directly take 텐데.
32d38edff2acd8be.zh: 「피곤해」是非格式體非終結形，不能直接加 텐데。

33b90ad44d9c02dd.zh: 「-는 길에」前面固定接動詞現在式冠形詞 -는，故用 가는。
33b90ad44d9c02dd.en: 가는 is the present modifying form of 가다 required before 길에.

33b90ad44d9c02dd.zh: 「간」是過去式冠形詞，不能與「-는 길에」搭配使用。
33b90ad44d9c02dd.en: 간 is the past modifying form, which cannot replace -는 in this pattern.

33b90ad44d9c02dd.zh: 「갈」是未來式冠形詞，不能與「-는 길에」搭配使用。
33b90ad44d9c02dd.en: 갈 is the future modifying form and does not fit the pattern -는 길에.

33b90ad44d9c02dd.zh: 「가」是動詞詞幹，不能直接修飾名詞 길。
33b90ad44d9c02dd.en: 가 is a bare verb stem and cannot directly modify the noun 길.

341b95a5e99dceeb.zh: 主詞與原因句 길이 미끄러워서 先行，後接表示差點摔倒的 넘어질 뻔했어요。
341b95a5e99dceeb.en: The clause 길이 미끄러워서 gives the cause, followed by 넘어질 뻔했어요 expressing almost falling.

35cba7aae6d8a222.en: 듣다 is a ㄷ-irregular verb; ㄷ becomes ㄹ before vowels, giving 들어도 (even though I listen).
35cba7aae6d8a222.zh: 「듣다」為ㄷ不規則動詞，遇元音變為ㄹ，故作「들어도」。

35cba7aae6d8a222.en: The ㄷ must change to ㄹ before a vowel; 듣어도 is ungrammatical.
35cba7aae6d8a222.zh: 「듣다」遇元音時ㄷ必須變為ㄹ，不能保留原形「듣어도」。

35cba7aae6d8a222.en: The ending requires -아/어도; 들도 is missing the connecting vowel 어.
35cba7aae6d8a222.zh: 接「-아/어도」時需保留詞幹核心並加元音，不可縮減成「들도」。

35cba7aae6d8a222.en: The concessive ending must be -아/어도, not simply -도 attached to the stem.
35cba7aae6d8a222.zh: 讓步句型需使用「-아/어도」，不能直接在詞幹後加「도」。

35f31c3c740d5daa.en: 에 따라 attaches to the nominalized form -ㅁ to mean as or in accordance with.
35f31c3c740d5daa.zh: 名詞化詞尾「-(으)ㅁ」後接「에 따라」，表示「隨著……」。

35f31c3c740d5daa.en: 을 따라 indicates physically following someone or a route, which does not fit here.
35f31c3c740d5daa.zh: 「을 따라」通常指沿著路線或跟隨某人，不符合抽象時間推進的句意。

35f31c3c740d5daa.en: 에 비해 means compared to and is used for comparison, not progressive change.
35f31c3c740d5daa.zh: 「에 비해」表示「相較於……」，用於對比而非表達隨之變化的過程。

35f31c3c740d5daa.en: 대신에 means instead of, which does not fit the intended meaning of change over time.
35f31c3c740d5daa.zh: 「대신에」表示「代替……」或「相反地」，與句子因果脈絡不符。

375cbfdb1392804a.zh: 副詞「잠깐」修飾「누웠다가」，再接副詞「그대로」修飾謂語「잠들었어요」。
375cbfdb1392804a.en: 잠깐 modifies 누웠다가, which connects via 았다가 to 그대로 and the final verb 잠들었어요.

37972ac5e4f1dc90.en: 추워서 uses -아서/어서 with an adjective to express the natural cause for staying at home.
37972ac5e4f1dc90.zh: 「추워서」為形容詞接一般因果句，天氣寒冷是待在家裡的原因。

37972ac5e4f1dc90.en: -느라고 can only attach to action verbs, never to adjectives like 춥다.
37972ac5e4f1dc90.zh: 「-느라고」只能接在動詞後面，不可用於形容詞「춥다」。

37972ac5e4f1dc90.en: 추우느라고 is an impossible form; adjectives cannot combine with -느라고.
춥도록 means to the degree of being cold, which does not express the cause for staying home.
37972ac5e4f1dc90.zh: 「춥도록」表示「冷到某種程度」，與待在家的因果關係不合。

37e90dfa36fdfa5b.zh: 主語「한국 사람들이」後接副詞「생각보다」，再接回想感受的謂語「친절하더라고요」。
37e90dfa36fdfa5b.en: Subject 한국 사람들이 precedes the comparative adverb 생각보다, followed by the recollection predicate 친절하더라고요.

390935a433ba026d.zh: 時間副詞接目的地 한국으로，再接受詞與句尾 -(으)ㄹ까 해요。
390935a433ba026d.en: Time adverb 내년에는 links to destination 한국으로, object 유학을, and the structure -(으)ㄹ까 해요.

39834166814c73cc.zh: 先述聊天原因 이야기하느라，再接否定受詞結構 전화를 못。
39834166814c73cc.en: First states the cause 이야기하느라 with 친구랑, followed by object 전화를 and negative adverb 못.

3bdb2147cbab9816.en: Vowel-final verbs contract -ㄴ다고 해요 into -ㄴ대요 in casual reported speech.
3bdb2147cbab9816.zh: 動詞「오다」無尾音，口語轉述現在/未來陳述句縮略為「-ㄴ대요」，選「온대요」。

3bdb2147cbab9816.en: Action verbs cannot directly attach -대요; vowel-final stems need -ㄴ대요.
3bdb2147cbab9816.zh: 動詞不能直接接「-대요」，無收音動詞需加上尾音ㄴ變成「-ㄴ대요」。

3bdb2147cbab9816.en: -데요 expresses the speaker's own past recollection, whereas hearsay uses -대요.
3bdb2147cbab9816.zh: 「-데요」是表達回想自己見聞的終結詞尾，轉述聽說的事情必須用「-대요」。

3bdb2147cbab9816.en: -래요 reports a command (short for -라고 해요), not a weather forecast statement.
3bdb2147cbab9816.zh: 「-래요」是命令句轉述縮略形（-라고 해요），此句是陳述天氣而非命令。

3bfe9514be5b5309.zh: 「-는 길이에요」為固定句型，表示「正要去…的路上」。
3bfe9514be5b5309.en: 길이에요 is the correct predicate form meaning I am on my way.

3bfe9514be5b5309.zh: 「길에요」誤用了副詞格助詞 에，結尾應用「名詞 + 이에요」。
3bfe9514be5b5309.en: 길에요 incorrectly uses the particle 에 instead of the copula ending 이에요.

3bfe9514be5b5309.zh: 「길로요」表示「朝著路」，無法表達「正要去…的路上」。
3bfe9514be5b5309.en: 길로요 uses the direction particle 로 and does not mean to be on one's way.

3bfe9514be5b5309.zh: 「길을요」使用了受格助詞 을，不能作為此句的肯定結尾。
3bfe9514be5b5309.en: 길을요 uses the object marker 을 and cannot serve as the predicate here.

3c8385bb7dd20c6d.en: Correct. The pattern -기는 하다 attaches directly to the adjective stem 어렵-.
3c8385bb7dd20c6d.zh: 正確。句型「-기는 하다」直接接在形容詞詞幹「어렵-」之後。

3c8385bb7dd20c6d.en: The suffix -기는 attaches to stems directly, not to the modified form 어려운.
3c8385bb7dd20c6d.zh: 「-기는」直接加在詞幹後，不需先變成冠形詞形「어려운」。

3c8385bb7dd20c6d.en: The suffix -기는 cannot attach to the conjugated form 어려워.
3c8385bb7dd20c6d.zh: 「-기는」不能加在非敬語口語結尾「어려워」之後。

3c8385bb7dd20c6d.en: Adjectives cannot take -는, and -기는 attaches directly to 어렵-.
3c8385bb7dd20c6d.zh: 形容詞詞幹不能加「-는」，且句型直接接詞幹即可。

3cd35f93f48acde9.zh: 正確。轉述對方的命令或要求時，動詞後面接「-(으)라고 하다」。
3cd35f93f48acde9.en: Correct. Use -(으)라고 하다 to report a command or request.

3cd35f93f48acde9.zh: 「-자고 하다」用於轉述提議（一起做……），不符合媽媽要求我的語境。
3cd35f93f48acde9.en: 청소하자고 reports a proposal to do something together, not an instruction to someone else.

3cd35f93f48acde9.zh: 「-냐고 하다」用於轉述疑問句，意思會變成問我是否打掃。
3cd35f93f48acde9.en: 청소하냐고 reports a question, meaning she asked whether I clean.

3cd35f93f48acde9.zh: 「-ㄴ/는다고 하다」用於轉述陳述句，不能表達指使或要求。
3cd35f93f48acde9.en: 청소한다고 reports a statement of fact, not an order.

3e26a63e9041f5ef.zh: 「시청에 가려면」表要去市廳的前提，後接疑問詞短語「몇 번 버스를」與動詞。
3e26a63e9041f5ef.en: 시청에 가려면 sets the destination condition, leading to the question phrase 몇 번 버스를.

412d086b8626444f.en: Correct. 만하다 functions as an adjective, so it takes -(으)ㄴ to modify 곳 as 만한.
412d086b8626444f.zh: 正確。「만하다」是形容詞，修飾名詞 곳 需用冠形詞形「만한」。

412d086b8626444f.en: Adjectives cannot take the present noun-modifying suffix -는; 만하는 is ungrammatical.
412d086b8626444f.zh: 「만하다」是形容詞，現在式修飾名詞不能接動詞用的「-는」。

412d086b8626444f.en: The future modifier 만할 indicates conjecture, whereas 만한 expresses the general quality.
412d086b8626444f.zh: 「만할」表示未來或推測修飾，此處表示「值得一去的」應用「만한」。

412d086b8626444f.en: The sentence-ending form 만해 cannot directly modify the noun 곳.
412d086b8626444f.zh: 「만해」是終結詞尾非敬語形式，不能直接放在名詞 곳 前面修飾。

41727aa96ff0aef4.zh: 時間狀語「내일까지」接賓語「이 일을」，再接句型「끝내지 않으면 안 돼요」。
41727aa96ff0aef4.en: Time adverb 내일까지 precedes object 이 일을, followed by verb predicate 끝내지 않으면 안 돼요.

42441d23c87aaf0e.zh: 時間詞在前，主語子句 민수 씨가 기분이 接 좋아 連接句尾 보여요。
42441d23c87aaf0e.en: Time word 오늘 comes first, followed by subject clause 민수 씨가 기분이 and 좋아 to complete 좋아 보여요.

4384734a66be5ca5.zh: 「-았거든요」表示向對方說明過去經歷的背景或原因：「住過五年呢」。
4384734a66be5ca5.en: The past form 살았거든요 explains a past reason or background that the listener does not know.

4384734a66be5ca5.zh: 「살거든요」是現在式，題意是過去住了五年，現在不一定在住。
4384734a66be5ca5.en: 살거든요 is present tense, but the sentence describes a completed past duration of five years.

4384734a66be5ca5.zh: 「-잖거든요」是將兩個終結語尾錯誤拼湊，不存在此形態。
4384734a66be5ca5.en: The ending -잖거든요 is an incorrect combination of two sentence endings.

4384734a66be5ca5.zh: 「-더라고요」是用於分享自己親自看見的新發現，而非向對方解釋原因。
4384734a66be5ca5.en: The ending -더라고요 reports a newly observed recollection, rather than providing an explanatory reason to the listener.

4741754e84a29261.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 만하다」為形容詞，非格式體現在式為「만해요」。
4741754e84a29261.en: -(으)ㄹ 만하다 functions as an adjective, conjugating to 만해요 in the informal polite style.

4741754e84a29261.zh: 「만하다」是形容詞，基本階現在式應為「만하다」而非「만한다」。
4741754e84a29261.en: As an adjective, its plain present form is 만하다, not 만한다.

4741754e84a29261.zh: 語法為「-(으)ㄹ 만하다」，沒有「만 있다」的用法。
4741754e84a29261.en: The grammar pattern is -(으)ㄹ 만하다, not 만 있다.

4741754e84a29261.zh: 「하다」的非格式體詞尾變化為「해요」，而非「하어요」。
4741754e84a29261.en: The stem 하- combines with -여요 to form 해요, not 하어요.

47cf895f7b82aa24.zh: 否定形式「늦지 않도록」放句首表目的，後接副詞「일찍」與述語「출발하세요」。
47cf895f7b82aa24.en: 늦지 않도록 expresses purpose so as not to be late, followed by 일찍 출발하세요.

47d8b3786deb8f76.en: 피곤하다 combines with the concessive ending -아/어도 to form 피곤해도.
하다 combines with -아/어도 to form 해도, not 하도.

47d8b3786deb8f76.zh: 「-어서도」表示「即使因為…也」，與副詞「아무리」搭配不自然。
47d8b3786deb8f76.en: -아서/어서도 expresses because/even with, which clashes with 아무리 (no matter how).

47d8b3786deb8f76.zh: 「-면」表示假定條件「如果」，無法與「아무리」（無論多麼）呼應。
47d8b3786deb8f76.en: -면 expresses a simple condition (if), which does not pair with 아무리 (no matter how).

4842a3bb2d1aa7b4.en: Correct. 놓치다 has no final consonant, so it takes -ㄹ 뻔하다.
놓치다 ends in a vowel, so adding -을 in 놓치을 is incorrect.
놓친 is the past modifier form and cannot be followed by 뻔하다.
놓쳐 is an informal connective/ending form, not a modifier for 뻔.

48f2ab1ca3063359.en: 열었다가 correctly expresses opening the window and then reversing the action by closing it.
48f2ab1ca3063359.zh: 「열었다가」表示開了窗後又改變狀態將它關上，符合文意。

48f2ab1ca3063359.en: 열다가 means interrupting the action while opening the window, not undoing a completed action.
48f2ab1ca3063359.zh: 「열다가」表示開窗動作進行到一半中斷，不是開好後又關閉。

48f2ab1ca3063359.en: 열면서 means doing two actions simultaneously, which makes no sense with opening and closing.
48f2ab1ca3063359.zh: 「열면서」表示一邊開窗一邊關窗，語意相互矛盾。

48f2ab1ca3063359.en: 열려고 indicates intention or purpose (in order to open), which does not fit here.
48f2ab1ca3063359.zh: 「열려고」表示為了要開窗，與後面的因冷又關上不合。

491d6397b31b1f7e.en: 잘하다 ends in a vowel, so it attaches -ㄹ to form 잘할 뿐만 아니라.
491d6397b31b1f7e.zh: 句型「-(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라」接動詞詞幹時，無收音或「ㄹ」收音接「-ㄹ」。

491d6397b31b1f7e.en: 잘하는 uses the present modifier -는, but this pattern strictly requires -(으)ㄹ.
491d6397b31b1f7e.zh: 「잘하는」是現在式冠形詞尾，該句型固定使用「-(으)ㄹ」。

491d6397b31b1f7e.en: 잘한 is the past modifier and does not fit the -(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라 structure here.
491d6397b31b1f7e.zh: 「잘한」是過去式冠形詞尾，無法與「뿐만 아니라」搭配表示現有能力。

491d6397b31b1f7e.en: 잘해 is an inflected sentence-ending form and cannot modify the bound noun 뿐.
491d6397b31b1f7e.zh: 「잘해」是非格式體非冠形詞形，不能接依存名詞「뿐」。

4a92f77a164b758b.zh: 主詞「민수 씨가」後依序放時間「주말에」、副詞「같이」與提議轉述「놀재요」。
4a92f77a164b758b.en: Subject 민수 씨가 precedes time adverbial 주말에, adverb 같이, and the contracted proposal 놀재요.

4b37a61b38b5a875.en: Correct. The stem 하- attaches to -다가 to express falling asleep in the middle of studying.
4b37a61b38b5a875.zh: 正確。「하다」詞幹接「-다가」表示讀書途中睡著了。

4b37a61b38b5a875.en: 했다가 indicates that studying was completed before sleeping, rather than being interrupted.
4b37a61b38b5a875.zh: 「했다가」強調讀書動作已完全結束後才睡著，無法表達「途中睡著」。

4b37a61b38b5a875.en: 하러 expresses purpose of motion ('in order to do'), which does not fit here.
4b37a61b38b5a875.zh: 「하러」表示「為了做…」，表移動目的，文意不合。

4b37a61b38b5a875.en: 하도록 means 'so that' or 'to ensure', which makes no sense in this context.
4b37a61b38b5a875.zh: 「하도록」表示「為了讓…/使…」，表目的或程度，不符句意。

4c7679d77490608d.en: Correct. Compound adjectives like 맛있다 typically take -나 보다, forming 맛있나 봐요.
4c7679d77490608d.zh: 正確。맛있다 依慣例文法規則常接 -나 보다 構成 맛있나 봐요。

4c7679d77490608d.en: 맛있은가 is an incorrect conjugation; 맛있다 takes -나 보다.
4c7679d77490608d.zh: 「맛있은가」是不合語法的形態，맛있다 不接 -(으)ㄴ가。

4c7679d77490608d.en: 맛있는가나 is an incorrect and nonsensical combination of endings.
4c7679d77490608d.zh: 「맛있는가나」是混雜錯誤詞尾的不自然形式。

4c7679d77490608d.en: 맛있어 cannot directly combine with 봐요 to express this observational guess.
4c7679d77490608d.zh: 「맛있어」無法直接接 봐요 來表達「看樣子……」的推測句型。

4d6a817700f3c840.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ걸요」用於推測對方的提問，表示大概在公司。
4d6a817700f3c840.en: -(으)ㄹ걸요 expresses a casual guess or assumption, meaning he is probably there.

4d6a817700f3c840.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」表示說話者的承諾或意志，不能用於推測他人。
4d6a817700f3c840.en: -(으)ㄹ게요 expresses the speaker's own promise or intention, not a guess about someone else.

4d6a817700f3c840.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」表示說話者的意願或詢問意向，不符語境。
4d6a817700f3c840.en: -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses the speaker's intention or preference, not a guess.

4d6a817700f3c840.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ까요」用於提問或徵詢意見，回答時不能使用。
4d6a817700f3c840.en: -(으)ㄹ까요 is a question ending and cannot be used in a declarative answer.

4f66e784ff18584c.en: Correct. Stems ending in a vowel take -(으)ㄹ 만하다, making 볼 만해요.
4f66e784ff18584c.zh: 正確。動詞無尾音接「-(으)ㄹ 만하다」，形成「볼 만해요」。

4f66e784ff18584c.en: The ending -는 is a present noun-modifying suffix and cannot precede 만하다.
4f66e784ff18584c.zh: 「-는」是現在式冠形詞尾，不能與「만하다」搭配使用。

4f66e784ff18584c.en: The past modifier -ㄴ cannot be combined with the pattern 만하다.
4f66e784ff18584c.zh: 「-ㄴ」是過去式冠形詞尾，文法上不能與「만하다」搭配。

4f66e784ff18584c.en: The informal ending 봐 cannot attach directly to 만하다.
4f66e784ff18584c.zh: 「봐」是非格式體非敬語詞尾，不能直接接「만하다」。

4f9689ea570e1a91.zh: 主詞「동생이」接副詞「같이」，再接提議引語「산책하자고」與謂語「했어요」。
4f9689ea570e1a91.en: Subject 동생이 is followed by adverb 같이, then the reported proposal 산책하자고, ending with 했어요.

50d1d0f27f82123f.zh: 時間「밤에」與副詞「갑자기」修飾主謂結構「전화가 끊겼어요」。
50d1d0f27f82123f.en: Time adverbial 밤에 and adverb 갑자기 modify the passive clause 전화가 끊겼어요.

5194f9e919e016a5.en: Correct. 뻔하다 is typically conjugated into the past polite form 뻔했어요.
하다 conjugates in the past to 했-, so 뻔하었어요 is an incorrect form.
뻔해었어요 is grammatically incorrect; the correct past form is 뻔했어요.
뻔했었어요요 repeats the ending 요, which is grammatically invalid.

51c617f200985a79.en: 시험 ends with a final consonant, correctly requiring 이 before -거든요.
51c617f200985a79.zh: 名詞「시험」有收音，接「-거든요」需加「이」，表示明天的理由。

51c617f200985a79.en: 시험거든요 misses the copula stem 이 after a final consonant.
51c617f200985a79.zh: 「시험거든요」漏掉了有收音名詞所需的「이」，形態錯誤。

51c617f200985a79.en: 시험이었거든요 is in the past tense, which contradicts 내일 (tomorrow).
51c617f200985a79.zh: 「시험이었거든요」是過去式，與句子中的「내일（明天）」衝突。

51c617f200985a79.en: 시험인거든요 is ungrammatical; nominal sentences take -이거든요 directly.

5283a87d270631d6.zh: 「감기에 걸리지 않도록」表不感冒的目的，後接副詞「따뜻하게」修飾動作。
5283a87d270631d6.en: 감기에 걸리지 않도록 forms the purpose clause, followed by the adverb 따뜻하게.

52ed6e231889fa2f.zh: 「비자를 받으려면」構成前提條件，後接主語「이 서류가」與述語「필요해요」。
52ed6e231889fa2f.en: 비자를 받으려면 sets the condition if you want to get a visa, followed by subject 이 서류가 and 필요해요.

542467526e4bc0b4.zh: 「환경」有收音，名詞接「을 위해」表示為了某目的。
542467526e4bc0b4.en: 환경 ends in a final consonant, so 을 위해 correctly attaches to state a purpose.

542467526e4bc0b4.zh: 「를 위해」用於沒有收音的名詞後面。
542467526e4bc0b4.en: 를 위해 is used with nouns that end in a vowel.

542467526e4bc0b4.zh: 「이」是主格助詞，文法上沒有「이 위해」這種句型。
542467526e4bc0b4.en: 이 is a subject marker; 이 위해 is ungrammatical for expressing purpose.

542467526e4bc0b4.zh: 「의」是所有格助詞，不能與「위해」組成目的句型。
542467526e4bc0b4.en: 의 is a possessive particle and cannot form the purpose pattern here.

5671ead091f96604.en: 밤새도록 is an idiomatic expression using -도록 meaning all night long or until dawn.
5671ead091f96604.zh: 「밤새다」（熬夜）接「-도록」形成固定用法，表示「直到徹夜」。

5671ead091f96604.en: -거나 means or, which does not fit describing duration.
-다가 indicates an interrupted action, not continuous duration through the night.
5671ead091f96604.zh: 「-다가」表示中斷或轉移動作，不合「整夜暢談」之意。

5671ead091f96604.en: -면서 means while, but does not form the standard expression for doing something all night.
5671ead091f96604.zh: 「-면서」表示「一邊…一邊…」，無法與「밤새다」搭配表達整夜。

575424ac8f9a0e5e.en: Correct. -(으)ㄹ 뻔하다 expresses almost doing something, adding -ㄹ to a stem without a final consonant.
575424ac8f9a0e5e.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 뻔하다」表示差點，動詞無收音接「-ㄹ」。

575424ac8f9a0e5e.en: 넘어진 is the past noun-modifying form and cannot combine with 뻔하다.
넘어지는 is the present noun-modifying form, not used with 뻔하다.
575424ac8f9a0e5e.zh: 「넘어지는」是現在冠形詞形，不符合句型。

575424ac8f9a0e5e.en: 넘어져 is a connective verb ending and cannot modify the noun 뻔.
575424ac8f9a0e5e.zh: 「넘어져」是連接詞尾，不能修飾後面的名詞「뻔」。

585ab360ba23a942.zh: 「보다」無收音接「-려면」，表示「若想要看海」的條件前提。
585ab360ba23a942.en: 보다 ends in a vowel, so 보려면 correctly forms if you want to see.

585ab360ba23a942.zh: 「-려고」表示意圖，通常後接動作，不能直接接形容詞推薦句子。
585ab360ba23a942.en: 보려고 expresses intention and connects to action clauses, not recommendation sentences like this.

585ab360ba23a942.zh: 「-면서」表示同時做兩件事，語意變為「一邊看海一邊這家飯店很好」。
585ab360ba23a942.en: 보면서 means while seeing, which does not make logical sense here.

585ab360ba23a942.zh: 「-았/었으려면」非標準條件接尾詞，假設意圖時不用過去式。
585ab360ba23a942.en: 봤으려면 is ungrammatical; the intention conditional does not take past tense here.

59d357bd0b6b9a11.zh: 「-다가」表示開車途中發生了睏倦並轉移到休息。
59d357bd0b6b9a11.en: 하다가 correctly shows that becoming sleepy occurred in the middle of driving.

59d357bd0b6b9a11.zh: 「했다가」表示開車已完全結束才發生後續，此處是開車中途睏了。
59d357bd0b6b9a11.en: 했다가 implies the driving was completed before the next event, but here sleepiness happened during driving.

59d357bd0b6b9a11.zh: 「-도록」表示目的或程度「使能夠開車」，不符合文意。
59d357bd0b6b9a11.en: 하도록 means so that or to the extent of driving, which does not fit the context.

59d357bd0b6b9a11.zh: 「-려면」表示「想要開車的話」，為意圖假設，文意不通。
59d357bd0b6b9a11.en: 하려면 means if you intend to drive, which does not match getting sleepy and resting.

5a79e7b00a61850e.en: In passive sentences, the agent (mosquito) takes the particle 한테.
5a79e7b00a61850e.zh: 被動句中，動作的施事者（蚊子）後面需接助詞「한테」。

5a79e7b00a61850e.en: 가 marks the grammatical subject, but the speaker is the one bitten.
5a79e7b00a61850e.zh: 助詞「가」為主格助詞，此處被咬的主語是說話者本人。

5a79e7b00a61850e.en: 를 marks a direct object, not the agent of a passive verb.
5a79e7b00a61850e.zh: 助詞「를」為受格助詞，被動動詞前不能將施事者標為受詞。

5a79e7b00a61850e.en: 에서 marks location or origin, not the agent doing the biting.
5a79e7b00a61850e.zh: 助詞「에서」表示地點或來源，不能用來表示叮咬的施事者。

5c0436ca1cc08f4d.zh: 「-에 비해(서)」為固定慣用型，前面已有「-에」，此處選「비해」。
5c0436ca1cc08f4d.en: The comparative pattern is -에 비해; with 에 already in the prompt, 비해 completes it.

5c0436ca1cc08f4d.zh: 「비하고」是連接詞尾型態，並非表示比較基準的固定慣用型態。
5c0436ca1cc08f4d.en: 비하고 uses the connector -고 and is not the idiomatic comparative form.

5c0436ca1cc08f4d.zh: 「-자」表示「一……就……」，無法形成「相比」的文法結構。
5c0436ca1cc08f4d.en: The suffix -자 means as soon as, which cannot form the comparative pattern.

5c0436ca1cc08f4d.zh: 「-려고」表示意圖「為了要……」，無法用於表達客觀比較。
5c0436ca1cc08f4d.en: The ending -(으)려고 expresses intention (in order to), which does not express comparison.

5d14ecd737008117.zh: 形容詞間接引述直接在語幹後接「-다고 하다」，故為「춥다고」。
5d14ecd737008117.en: Adjectives take -다고 directly after the verb stem, forming 춥다고.

5d14ecd737008117.zh: 「-는다고」是用於有收音的動詞，形容詞不可使用。
5d14ecd737008117.en: -는다고 is only used with action verbs ending in a consonant, not adjectives.

5d14ecd737008117.zh: 「추운다고」是將冠形詞形誤用於間接引述的錯誤形態。
5d14ecd737008117.en: 추운다고 mistakenly attaches -다고 to the adnominal modifier 추운.

5d14ecd737008117.zh: 「-(으)라고 하다」用於命令句間接引述，此處是陳述句。
5d14ecd737008117.en: -(으)라고 is for quoting imperative sentences, not descriptive statements.

5ee07ca5dd819b36.zh: 「-아/어 버리다」前需接動詞語幹的連用形，故選「잠들어」。
5ee07ca5dd819b36.en: -아/어 버리다 requires the verb stem in -아/어 form, making 잠들어 correct.

5ee07ca5dd819b36.zh: 「-고」表示並列或順序，不能直接與「버리다」結合成補助動詞。
5ee07ca5dd819b36.en: -고 is a connective ending meaning 'and' and cannot combine with 버리다.

5ee07ca5dd819b36.zh: 「-ㄴ」是冠形詞形（定語）詞尾，後面必須接名詞。
5ee07ca5dd819b36.en: -ㄴ is a noun-modifying suffix and cannot precede the auxiliary verb 버리다.

5ee07ca5dd819b36.zh: 「-게」表示副詞化或目的，不能與補助動詞「버리다」連用。
5ee07ca5dd819b36.en: -게 turns a stem into an adverbial form and cannot combine with 버리다.

5ee52813befaac32.en: 많거든요 correctly attaches -거든요 to the stem 많- to explain a reason.
5ee52813befaac32.zh: 形容詞詞幹「많-」直接加「-거든요」，向對方說明不能去的理由。

5ee52813befaac32.en: 많잖거든요 incorrectly combines two contradictory sentence endings.
많더라거든요 is an ungrammatical blend of -더라 and -거든요.
많을까요 is a question asking for speculation, not providing an explanation.
5ee52813befaac32.zh: 「많을까요」表示詢問猜測「會很多嗎？」，無法用來解釋理由。

5f6c13a6b757a976.zh: 主詞「그 배우는」接受詞「연기를」，再接動詞搭配「잘할 뿐만 아니라」修飾後句。
5f6c13a6b757a976.en: Subject 그 배우는 takes object 연기를, ending with verb pattern 잘할 뿐만 아니라 to connect to the next clause.

5fabb6ab315c6191.zh: 動詞現在式接「-는 대신(에)」表示交換或補償條件，意為「代之以……」。
5fabb6ab315c6191.en: The pattern -는 대신(에) expresses a trade-off or compensation: in exchange for working.

5fabb6ab315c6191.zh: 韓語中沒有「대신에서」這種接續副詞格助詞的用法。
5fabb6ab315c6191.en: 대신 does not combine with 에서 to form a connective structure.

5fabb6ab315c6191.zh: 「동안」表示「在……期間」，無法表達換取下週休假的補償關係。
5fabb6ab315c6191.en: 동안 means during or while, which fails to convey the trade-off meaning.

5fabb6ab315c6191.zh: 「때문에」表示因果關係「因為……」，與後半句補償休假的語意不合。
5fabb6ab315c6191.en: 때문에 means because of, turning the weekend work into a causal reason rather than an exchange.

5fe50024d54c1faa.en: 가던 modifies nouns to recall a past habitual action, fitting the memory.
5fe50024d54c1faa.zh: 「가던」接名詞，回想過去常去或未完成的習慣，符合句意。

5fe50024d54c1faa.en: 가는 is the present-tense modifier, meaning a park you go to now.
5fe50024d54c1faa.zh: 「가는」是現在式定語，表示「現在經常去的」，不符合兒時回憶。

5fe50024d54c1faa.en: 갈 indicates future intention, which does not fit a childhood memory.
5fe50024d54c1faa.zh: 「갈」是將來式定語，表示「將要去的」，與兒時過去時間不符。

5fe50024d54c1faa.en: 간다 is a plain declarative sentence ending and cannot modify the noun 공원.
5fe50024d54c1faa.zh: 「간다」是陳述句終結詞尾，不能直接修飾名詞「공원」。

6127da6c11842731.zh: 正確。動詞無尾音時接「-ㄴ대요」，是「-는다고 해요」的口語縮略型。
6127da6c11842731.en: Correct. 온대요 is the casual contraction of the statement form 오+ㄴ다고 해요.

6127da6c11842731.zh: 動詞現在式陳述句轉述應為「-ㄴ대요/는대요」，不能直接接「-대요」。
6127da6c11842731.en: 오대요 is missing the required present-tense verb modifier ㄴ.

6127da6c11842731.zh: 「온데요」是「-ㄴ데요」（說明背景、緩和語氣），不是轉述；轉述別人說的話要用「-ㄴ대요」。
6127da6c11842731.en: 온데요 is -ㄴ데요 (giving background, softening), not reported speech; reporting what someone said is -ㄴ대요.

6127da6c11842731.zh: 「-재요」是提議句「-자고 해요」的縮寫，不符合單純陳述不來的語意。
6127da6c11842731.en: 온재요 is not a standard form; suggestions use -재요 directly on verb stems without ㄴ.

61592cad5a2f1f9a.zh: 「-지 않도록」是固定否定形式，表示「為了不…」、「以便不…」。
61592cad5a2f1f9a.en: 않도록 combines the negative auxiliary 않다 with -도록 to mean so that not.

61592cad5a2f1f9a.zh: 「않게도록」重疊了 -게 與 -도록 兩個語尾，文法錯誤。
61592cad5a2f1f9a.en: 않게도록 awkwardly doubles the endings -게 and -도록, which is ungrammatical.

61592cad5a2f1f9a.zh: 「-(으)려고」前後主詞必須相同，且不能接在命令句中。
61592cad5a2f1f9a.en: 않으려고 cannot be used here because the main clause is an imperative sentence.

61592cad5a2f1f9a.zh: 「안도록」拼寫錯誤，-지 後面必須接長型否定 않다。
61592cad5a2f1f9a.en: 안도록 is incorrect; the long negative following -지 requires 않다, not 안.

618f6fbe726ac49b.en: 맛있더라고요 conveys your firsthand experience of how delicious it tasted.
618f6fbe726ac49b.zh: 「맛있더라고요」表示說話者親自品嚐後感受到的經驗，符合句意。

618f6fbe726ac49b.en: 맛있자고요 is ungrammatical; adjectives cannot take propositive -자고.
618f6fbe726ac49b.zh: 「맛있자고요」是不合文法的共動句形式，形容詞不能接「-자고」。

618f6fbe726ac49b.en: 맛있으세요 is an honorific form, not used for one's own impression.
618f6fbe726ac49b.zh: 「맛있으세요」是敬語祈使或詢問，不能用於陳述自己的感受。

618f6fbe726ac49b.en: 맛있읍시다 is a propositive ending, which cannot be used with adjectives.
618f6fbe726ac49b.zh: 「맛있읍시다」是提議句尾，形容詞無法做共動句提議。

62a97965820e894f.zh: 「-아/어 놓다」表示事先做好某動作並維持其狀態，故選「맞춰 놓았어요」。
62a97965820e894f.en: -아/어 놓다 expresses doing something in advance; 맞춰 놓았어요 correctly indicates past completion.
-고 cannot combine with 놓다; this grammar pattern strictly requires -아/어.

62a97965820e894f.zh: 「-으세요」是請對方做某事的命令句，不符合自己設好鬧鐘的陳述。
62a97965820e894f.en: -으세요 is an imperative form telling the listener to do something, unfitting a self-statement.

62a97965820e894f.zh: 「-(으)러」表示目的（為了去做…），不能用於句末結尾。
62a97965820e894f.en: -(으)러 indicates purpose ('in order to') and cannot end the sentence here.

6301db30c6979e6a.zh: 「먹다」母音為「ㅓ」，接陰性母音「-어도」，表示「就算吃很多」。
6301db30c6979e6a.en: 먹다 has the vowel ㅓ, so it takes -어도 to mean even if I eat.
Because 먹다 has a non-bright vowel ㅓ, it cannot combine with -아도.

6301db30c6979e6a.zh: 讓步句型需結合「-아/어도」，不能直接在語幹後接「-도」。
6301db30c6979e6a.en: The concessive ending requires -아/어도; -도 cannot attach directly to the verb stem.

6301db30c6979e6a.zh: 「-(으)면」表示假定「如果吃了」，語意非「即使吃很多也……」。
6301db30c6979e6a.en: 먹으면 expresses a condition (if I eat), not the concessive meaning even if.

6347ba7323f65dfc.zh: 「-기는 하다」表「雖然…確實是…」，動詞詞幹接「보기는」。
6347ba7323f65dfc.en: The concession pattern -기는 하다 attaches -기는 directly to the stem 보-.

6347ba7323f65dfc.zh: 「보는」為冠形詞形，後方應接名詞而非「했는데」。
6347ba7323f65dfc.en: The form 보는 modifies a noun, not 했本体 in this grammar pattern.

6347ba7323f65dfc.zh: 此讓步句型固定使用助詞「는」，不能用受格助詞「를」。
6347ba7323f65dfc.en: The pattern specifically uses the topic particle 는, not the object marker 를.

6347ba7323f65dfc.zh: 此讓步句型固定使用助詞「는」，不能用主格助詞「가」。
6347ba7323f65dfc.en: The pattern requires the contrastive particle 는, not the subject marker 가.

64bd61e9ca0f52e4.en: Correct. -지 않으면 forms the standard double negative pattern for obligation.
64bd61e9ca0f52e4.zh: 「-지 않으면 안 되다」為固定句型，表「不去不行」。

64bd61e9ca0f52e4.en: 안으면 comes from the verb 안다 (to hug), not the negative auxiliary 않다.
64bd61e9ca0f52e4.zh: 「안으면」是「擁抱（안다）」的接續，拼寫與語意皆錯誤。

64bd61e9ca0f52e4.en: 않아서 expresses reason (because not going), which does not form this obligation pattern.
64bd61e9ca0f52e4.zh: 「-지 않아서」表原因「因為沒去」，無法接「안 돼요」。

64bd61e9ca0f52e4.en: 않고 means without doing, which does not fit the conditional double negative.
64bd61e9ca0f52e4.zh: 「-지 않고」表示「不去做而…」，無法與「안 돼요」搭配。

64cb956454909f2a.en: 에 is the correct particle used with 비해 to mean compared with.
64cb956454909f2a.zh: 「에 비해」是固定句型，名詞後面必須搭配助詞「에」。

64cb956454909f2a.en: 을 is an object marker and cannot pair with 비해 to indicate a comparison standard.
64cb956454909f2a.zh: 「을」是受格助詞，不能與「비해」搭配表達比較基準。

64cb956454909f2a.en: 이 is a subject marker, whereas the pattern requires the locative particle 에.
64cb956454909f2a.zh: 「이」是主格助詞，此處需要與「비해」連用的助詞「에」。

64cb956454909f2a.en: 보다 itself means than, so placing it directly before 비해 is redundant and ungrammatical.
64cb956454909f2a.zh: 「보다」本身即可表比較，但不能直接與後面的「비해」疊用。

662aea84fd6c8b50.zh: 時間副詞 지금까지 與 열심히 修飾受詞 한국어를，最後接 공부해 왔어요。
662aea84fd6c8b50.en: The adverbs 지금까지 and 열심히 precede the object 한국어를, concluding with 공부해 to link to 왔어요.

66d4f7767af3be39.en: 갔을걸요 correctly pairs the past stem with -(으)ㄹ걸요 to guess that he has already gone.
66d4f7767af3be39.zh: 「벌써」與過去推測「갔을걸요」搭配，表示「民秀大概已經回家了」。

66d4f7767af3be39.en: 가을걸요 is grammatically incorrect; the past stem of 가다 is 갔-, not 가-.
66d4f7767af3be39.zh: 「가다」的推測過去式需使用「갔-」，「가을걸요」形態錯誤且缺乏過去意涵。

66d4f7767af3be39.en: 갔자고요 is ungrammatical; proposal endings cannot attach to past stems.
66d4f7767af3be39.zh: 「-자고요」是提議句型，不能接在過去式「갔-」後表達推測。

66d4f7767af3be39.en: 갔으세요 incorrectly combines the past tense with the ending -(으)세요.

683c23aa00099718.zh: 「-했잖아요」是過去式接「-잖아요」，提醒對方「之前不是說過了嗎」。
683c23aa00099718.en: The past tense form 했잖아요 correctly reminds the listener of what was already said.

683c23aa00099718.zh: 「-잖아요」直接接在詞幹後，不存在「-ㄹ잖아요」這種形態。
683c23aa00099718.en: The ending -잖아요 attaches directly to verb stems; the pattern -ㄹ잖아요 is grammatically incorrect.

683c23aa00099718.zh: 「-자고요」是提議的引用句型，意思完全不同且語法不通。
683c23aa00099718.en: The form -자고요 is a proposal quotation and does not mean reminding someone of a known fact.

683c23aa00099718.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」表達意願或詢問打算，不能用來提醒已知的事實。
683c23aa00099718.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses intent or inquiries, not reminding someone of previous information.

69b5247c6e7a6fd1.en: Correct. 끝내- combines with -어 to form 끝내 before 버리다.
69b5247c6e7a6fd1.zh: 「끝내다」詞尾帶有母音「ㅐ」，直接接「버리다」構成「끝내 버리다」。

69b5247c6e7a6fd1.en: -고 means and, which does not form the auxiliary verb pattern -아/어 버리다.
69b5247c6e7a6fd1.zh: 「-고」表示並列，不能與輔助動詞「버리다」連用表達完結。

69b5247c6e7a6fd1.en: 끝낼 is a future modifier and cannot be followed directly by 버리다.
69b5247c6e7a6fd1.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」是未來式冠詞形修飾語，不能連接「버리다」。

69b5247c6e7a6fd1.en: -게 turns verbs into adverbs and cannot connect to 버리다.
69b5247c6e7a6fd1.zh: 「-게」表示副詞化或目的，無法連接「버리다」。

6b25d112cf874886.en: The verb stem 먹- ends in a consonant, so it takes -는다고 for reported statements.
6b25d112cf874886.zh: 動詞「먹다」有尾音，間接引用現在式陳述接「-는다고 하다」。

6b25d112cf874886.en: -ㄴ다고 is only used with vowel-final verb stems, not 먹-.
6b25d112cf874886.zh: 「-ㄴ다고」用於無尾音的動詞幹，有尾音的「먹다」不能接「-ㄴ다고」。

6b25d112cf874886.en: -다고 is attached directly to adjectives; action verbs like 먹다 require -는다고.
6b25d112cf874886.zh: 「-다고 하다」直接接在形容詞後，動詞「먹다」必須接「-는다고」。

6b25d112cf874886.en: -(으)라고 reports an imperative (and 먹다 would take 먹으라고), not a plain statement.
6b25d112cf874886.zh: 「-(으)라고 하다」表示命令句引用，若指吃飯陳述不可用「먹라고」。

6ded6d11e3557cb7.en: 따라 completes the set grammar pattern 에 따라(서) meaning depending on.
6ded6d11e3557cb7.zh: 「에 따라(서)」為固定文法，此處搭配助詞「에」填入「따라」。

6ded6d11e3557cb7.en: 따르서 is grammatically incorrect; the correct conjugation with -아서/어서 is 따라서.
따라도요 means even if one follows, which does not make sense in this context.
6ded6d11e3557cb7.zh: 「따라도요」帶有「即使跟隨也」之意，形態與語意皆不適用於此。

6ded6d11e3557cb7.en: 따를수록 means the more one follows, which does not express depending on.
6ded6d11e3557cb7.zh: 「따를수록」表示「越跟隨就越……」，不符合句型與句意。

6ededc9812033670.zh: 「손님이 오기 전에」表時間子句，動詞「청소해」接後方的補助動詞「놓을게요」。
6ededc9812033670.en: The time clause 손님이 오기 전에 comes first, and 청소해 connects to the following 놓을게요.

6f515171e02d9e7f.zh: 地點「서울에서」接修飾語「가 볼 만한」，修飾名詞「곳을 추천해 주세요」。
6f515171e02d9e7f.en: Location 서울에서 modifies 가 볼 만한, which modifies the noun object 곳을 before 추천해 주세요.

70e4304c8ae7beed.en: The stem 하- combines with the background/contrast connective ending -(으)ㄴ데 to form 한데.

70e4304c8ae7beed.zh: 「하데」是回想的語尾（＝하더라），不能用來連接後面的轉折句；要說「편하기는 한데」。
70e4304c8ae7beed.en: 하데 is a recalling ending (= 하더라) and cannot link to the contrast that follows; say 편하기는 한데.

70e4304c8ae7beed.zh: 「-고서」表示前後動作的先後順序，無法表達轉折對比語氣。
70e4304c8ae7beed.en: The connective -고서 indicates sequential action, not the contrast needed here.

70e4304c8ae7beed.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래」表示意圖或詢問意願，無法連接後面的轉折子句。
70e4304c8ae7beed.en: The ending -(으)ㄹ래 expresses speaker intention and cannot connect these contrasting clauses.

71a5786f25a65162.zh: 「밥을 먹다가」是吃到一半，後面接突然發生的「배가 갑자기 아팠어요」。
71a5786f25a65162.en: 밥을 먹다가 is "in the middle of eating", followed by what suddenly happened: 배가 갑자기 아팠어요.

723c98e1b40fc5f6.zh: 「가다」無收音接「-ㄹ까」，搭配「해요」表示考慮去旅行。
723c98e1b40fc5f6.en: 가다 ends in a vowel, correctly taking -ㄹ까 to form 갈까 해요.

723c98e1b40fc5f6.zh: 「가다」無收音，不能加媒介音「으」，形態錯誤。
723c98e1b40fc5f6.en: 가을까 is an incorrect form; vowel stems attach -ㄹ directly.

723c98e1b40fc5f6.zh: 「갔을까」是過去推測形式，不能與「해요」搭配表示未來的考慮。
723c98e1b40fc5f6.en: 갔을까 is a past speculation form and cannot express an upcoming plan with 해요.

723c98e1b40fc5f6.zh: 「가기」是名詞形，不能接「해요」構成打算做某事的句型。
723c98e1b40fc5f6.en: 가기 is a nominalized verb and does not complete the pattern -(으)ㄹ까 하다.

732432793b18cdf9.en: 좋아하잖아요 correctly attaches -잖아요 to the verb stem 좋아하-.
732432793b18cdf9.zh: 「좋아하다」詞幹直接加「-잖아요」，提醒共知事實，形式正確。

732432793b18cdf9.en: 좋아하잖요 is a misspelling of the ending -잖아요.
좋아잖아요 drops the syllable 하 from 좋아하다, making it wrong.
좋아해잖아요 mistakenly inserts the -해 conjugation before -잖아요.

73487c01eddb14e2.zh: 正解。動詞 쓰다 詞幹直接接 -느라고 表因忙於該動作導致沒睡好。
73487c01eddb14e2.en: Correct. Verb stem 쓰- directly attaches -느라고 to indicate the reason for not sleeping.

73487c01eddb14e2.zh: 拼寫錯誤。-느라고 接在詞幹後，不是接在非格式體 -어 後面。
73487c01eddb14e2.en: Incorrect conjugation. -느라고 attaches directly to the stem, not the -아/어 form.

73487c01eddb14e2.zh: -느라고 前面不能使用過去式標記 -았/었-。
73487c01eddb14e2.en: -느라고 cannot be preceded by the past tense marker -았/었-.

73487c01eddb14e2.zh: 意為「為了寫」，表意圖目的，無法合理解釋後句「沒睡成覺」。
73487c01eddb14e2.en: Means in order to write; expresses intention rather than an excuse for a negative outcome.

7490d438fb9e1d4b.en: Correct. 만들다 takes -어 before 놓다 to express doing something in advance.
7490d438fb9e1d4b.zh: 「만들다」的詞幹接「-어 놓다」表示事先做好準備。

7490d438fb9e1d4b.en: -고 cannot pair with 놓다 to express the advance preparation grammar.
7490d438fb9e1d4b.zh: 「-고」表示連接前後子句，無法與「놓다」構成此文法。

7490d438fb9e1d4b.en: -게 means so that and does not fit the -아/어 놓다 pattern.
7490d438fb9e1d4b.zh: 「-게」表示程度或目的，不符合「-아/어 놓다」的格式。

7490d438fb9e1d4b.en: -(으)러 means in order to and does not combine with 놓다.

769600149b0b60af.zh: 「-자마자」直接接在詞幹「끝나-」後，表示一結束就立刻離開。
769600149b0b60af.en: 끝나자마자 attaches directly to the verb stem to express as soon as class ended.

769600149b0b60af.zh: 「-자마자」前不可加過去式標記「-았/었-」，此形式錯誤。
769600149b0b60af.en: 자마자 cannot be attached to past-tense stems like 끝났-; only bare stems are used.

769600149b0b60af.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中途中斷，而非一下課就立刻發生。
769600149b0b60af.en: 끝나다가 would imply an interruption during ending, which is ungrammatical and incorrect.

769600149b0b60af.zh: 「-려면」表示「若想要結束」，此處為已發生的客觀事件，不合文意。
769600149b0b60af.en: 끝나려면 means if it is to end, which is an intention/condition and does not fit.

77dbcf6c935db4ee.zh: 受詞「비밀을」和對象「친구에게」置於前方，動詞「말해」接補助動詞「버렸어요」。
77dbcf6c935db4ee.en: The object 비밀을 and indirect object 친구에게 precede the verb 말해, followed by auxiliary 버렸어요.

7935b757c41c6944.en: Action verbs take -는 대신 in the present tense to express a trade-off.
7935b757c41c6944.zh: 動詞「요리하다」現在式接「-는 대신」，表示做飯作為條件交換。

7935b757c41c6944.en: For current bargains or duties, the present form 요리하는 대신 is used rather than 요리할.
7935b757c41c6944.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 대신」不符此處約定條件「我做飯（相對地你洗碗）」的語法習慣。

7935b757c41c6944.en: 요리해 is an informal ending and cannot modify the noun 대신 directly.
7935b757c41c6944.zh: 「요리해」為口語終結詞尾，無法直接修飾依存名詞「대신」。

7935b757c41c6944.en: -고 is a connective suffix meaning and, which cannot directly combine with 대신.
7935b757c41c6944.zh: 「-고」為並列連接詞尾，無法與後續的「대신」構成片語。

7a27ad007db7d03e.zh: 名詞「선물」後接「대신」表示代替，後方接賓語「현금을」與敬語動詞「드렸어요」。
7a27ad007db7d03e.en: 선물 connects with 대신 meaning instead of a gift, followed by object 현금을 and verb 드렸어요.

7af85b22e28f4e72.en: Correct. The noun followed by 처럼 보이다 means look like.
7af85b22e28f4e72.zh: 正確。名詞後接 처럼 보이다 表示「看起來像……」。

7af85b22e28f4e72.en: 이 is the subject particle, meaning the student is visible, not looks like.
7af85b22e28f4e72.zh: 「이」是主格助詞，학생이 보이다 會變成「看得到學生」。

7af85b22e28f4e72.en: 을 is the object particle and cannot be used with the verb 보이다 here.
7af85b22e28f4e72.zh: 「을」是受格助詞，與被動/自動詞 보이다 不搭配。

7af85b22e28f4e72.en: 에 is a location or time particle, making the sentence nonsensical here.
7af85b22e28f4e72.zh: 「에」是表示場所或時間的助詞，意思不通順。

7becff52a657ded8.zh: 主詞「비가」接讓步副詞子句「와도」，再接受詞「축구를」與未來式謂語「할」。
7becff52a657ded8.en: The subject 비가 connects to 와도 for even if it rains, followed by object 축구를 and future stem 할.

7cec11d33de44cd4.en: The pattern -기 위해(서) expresses doing something for the purpose of an action.
7cec11d33de44cd4.zh: 動詞「-기 위해(서)」為固定文法，表示「為了達成某目的」。

7cec11d33de44cd4.en: 때문에 indicates cause or reason rather than an intended goal.
7cec11d33de44cd4.zh: 「때문에」表示原因而非單純意圖，且名詞形應接「-기 때문에」。

7cec11d33de44cd4.en: 동안 means during or while and typically follows -는, not -기.
7cec11d33de44cd4.zh: 「동안」表示「期間」，通常與冠形詞形「-는 동안」搭配使用。

7cec11d33de44cd4.en: 김에 means while one is at it and requires an adnominal ending, not -기.
7cec11d33de44cd4.zh: 「김에」意為「順便」，前方須接冠形詞「-(으)ㄴ/는 김에」。

7dbb6f9e40b9be20.zh: 主語「그 일은」接副詞「혼자」，後接動詞句型「할 만해요」。
7dbb6f9e40b9be20.en: Subject 그 일은 takes adverb 혼자, followed by the predicate 할 만해요.

7e7e2e7bfb48bce6.en: Verbs ending in 하다 conjugate to 해야겠다 when combined with -아/어야겠다.
하다 combines with -아/어 to form 해, so 하야겠어요 is grammatically incorrect.

7e7e2e7bfb48bce6.zh: 「-아/어야겠다」本身表當下的決心，雙重過去式「-겠었어요」不自然。
7e7e2e7bfb48bce6.en: -아/어야겠다 expresses a current intention; combining it with double past -겠었어요 is ungrammatical.

7e7e2e7bfb48bce6.zh: 「-았/었어야겠다」文法錯誤，表達當下打算應用「-해야겠다」。
7e7e2e7bfb48bce6.en: 공부했어야겠다 puts the past tense on the stem, which is incorrect for expressing an immediate resolution.

7fe60187a26c1267.en: The grammar pattern requires the nominalizer -기 attached to the verb stem before 위해서.
7fe60187a26c1267.zh: 文法規則為動詞名詞形「-기」加上「위해서」，意為「為了…」。

7fe60187a26c1267.en: -는 is an adnominal modifier suffix, which cannot be directly followed by 위해서.
7fe60187a26c1267.zh: 「-는」是定語冠形詞形，後面不能直接接「위해서」。

7fe60187a26c1267.en: -ㄴ is a past participle modifier and cannot precede 위해서.
7fe60187a26c1267.zh: 「-ㄴ」為過去定語形，不能接在「위해서」前面。

7fe60187a26c1267.en: -게 makes an adverbial form and cannot precede 위해서.

803e443950d88d8c.en: 걸렸거든요 uses past tense with -거든요 to explain you caught a cold.
803e443950d88d8c.zh: 「걸렸거든요」用過去式說明「昨天就感冒了」作為無法前去的理由。

803e443950d88d8c.en: 걸리자고요 is a proposal meaning let's catch, which makes no sense.
803e443950d88d8c.zh: 「걸리자고요」是提議句「我們一起得感冒吧」，文意荒謬且不符。

803e443950d88d8c.en: 걸릴래요 expresses intention to catch a cold, which is nonsensical.
803e443950d88d8c.zh: 「걸릴래요」表示意願「我想要感冒」，語意完全不合理。

803e443950d88d8c.en: 걸리세요 is an imperative telling someone to catch a cold.
803e443950d88d8c.zh: 「걸리세요」是命令句「請感冒」，不能用來解釋自己不去的理由。

817aa1d74739fdbd.en: 가져가다 takes -아야겠다 to state a personal decision: I should take it.
817aa1d74739fdbd.zh: 「가져가다」接「-아야겠다」表示說話者決定該帶雨傘。

817aa1d74739fdbd.en: 가져갈 뻔했다 means I almost took it, which does not fit.
817aa1d74739fdbd.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 뻔했다」表示差一點發生，意為「差點帶走」。

817aa1d74739fdbd.en: 가져가 버렸다 means took it away completely, expressing finished action.
817aa1d74739fdbd.zh: 「-어 버리다」表示動作完成或遺憾，意為「帶走了」。

817aa1d74739fdbd.en: 가져간 적이 있다 expresses past experience: have taken it before.
817aa1d74739fdbd.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 적이 있다」表示過往經驗，意為「曾經帶過」。

822e4f7813de784f.zh: 「-더라고요」用於形容詞詞幹後，表示轉述自己親眼所見「人很多」。
822e4f7813de784f.en: Attach -더라고요 to the adjective stem to report your direct observation that it was crowded.

822e4f7813de784f.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」用於表達個人意圖或詢問意願，不能與形容詞「많다」搭配。
822e4f7813de784f.en: The ending -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses personal intentions or invites someone, which does not fit the adjective 많다.

822e4f7813de784f.zh: 「-(으)ㅂ시다」是共動句（提議）終結詞尾，不能用於形容詞。
822e4f7813de784f.en: The ending -(으)ㅂ시다 is a suggestive proposal form and cannot attach to adjectives.

822e4f7813de784f.zh: 「-(으)세요」用於對聽話者或主語的尊敬命令或描述，形容詞人多不合適。
822e4f7813de784f.en: The ending -(으)세요 is an honorific form and makes no sense describing crowdedness here.

82a7b09375891375.en: With 에 already present, 비해서 correctly completes the pattern 에 비해서 meaning compared with.
82a7b09375891375.zh: 前面已有「에」，選「비해서」構成「에 비해서」（與…相比）。

82a7b09375891375.en: 비하고 is ungrammatical; the comparative pattern requires the -어서 form, not -고.
82a7b09375891375.zh: 「비하고」接續詞尾不符合「에 비해(서)」的固定比較語法。

82a7b09375891375.en: 비해도요 combines an even if ending with a polite particle, which does not fit grammatically.
82a7b09375891375.zh: 「비해도요」是讓步語尾加句尾助詞，無法在此處作狀語修飾。

82a7b09375891375.en: 비하려고 means in order to compare, which does not match the comparative context.
82a7b09375891375.zh: 「비하려고」表示「為了比較」，語義與語法結構皆不符。

82b4fa2e2cac69f6.en: 하자마자 attaches directly to 하다 to mean as soon as you arrive.
82b4fa2e2cac69f6.zh: 「하자마자」接在動詞詞幹後，表示一到達就請打電話。

82b4fa2e2cac69f6.en: 했자마자 is incorrect because past tense markers cannot precede -자마자.
82b4fa2e2cac69f6.zh: 「했자마자」在-자마자前誤加了過去式標記，文法不正確。

82b4fa2e2cac69f6.en: 하마자 is a misspelling missing the syllable 자 from -자마자.
82b4fa2e2cac69f6.zh: 「하마자」字形錯誤，正確的句型詞尾應為完整的一組-자마자。

82b4fa2e2cac69f6.en: 하면서 indicates simultaneous actions (while arriving), which does not fit calling upon arrival.
82b4fa2e2cac69f6.zh: 「하면서」表示一邊到達一邊打電話，無法在到達瞬間同時進行。

844562651f5b0a90.zh: 時間「내일」接主詞「날씨가」，副詞「아주」修飾形容詞轉述結尾「춥대요」。
844562651f5b0a90.en: Time word 내일 introduces subject 날씨가, adverb 아주 modifies the contracted reported adjective 춥대요.

859f535ea273cb6c.en: 샀다가 correctly expresses completing the purchase and then undoing it by exchanging the item.
859f535ea273cb6c.zh: 「샀다가」表示買了衣服之後又改變動作拿去換，完全正確。

859f535ea273cb6c.en: 사다가 means buying in the middle of an action or buying to bring somewhere else.
859f535ea273cb6c.zh: 「사다가」表示買衣服的動作中途停止，或買來帶給別人。

859f535ea273cb6c.en: 사면서 means while buying, implying simultaneous actions that do not fit logically here.
859f535ea273cb6c.zh: 「사면서」表示一邊買一邊換，兩動作在邏輯上無法同時發生。

859f535ea273cb6c.en: 사거나 means or buying, which expresses an alternative rather than sequential actions.
859f535ea273cb6c.zh: 「사거나」表示或者買，表二選一，與接續原因換貨不合。

86807cb7cc9d048b.en: Correct. 잃어버리다 is standard, and -렸어요 is the past tense ending.
86807cb7cc9d048b.zh: 「잃어버리다」是固定慣用語，過去式縮合為「잃어버렸어요」。

86807cb7cc9d048b.en: 버리- plus -었어요 normally contracts to 버렸어요.
86807cb7cc9d048b.zh: 「-리었어요」在現代韓語中一般必須縮合為「-렸어요」。

86807cb7cc9d048b.en: The grammar requires -아/어, not the connector -고.
86807cb7cc9d048b.zh: 文法結構為「-아/어 버리다」，不能用連接詞「-고」。

86807cb7cc9d048b.en: 잃어버려요었어요 mixes present and past endings incorrectly.
86807cb7cc9d048b.zh: 現在式與過去式詞尾重複疊加，為錯誤語法形式。

8731ebd95fb3aa4b.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 뻔하다」表示差點……，치이다 接 -ㄹ 成為 치일。
8731ebd95fb3aa4b.en: Correct. -(으)ㄹ 뻔하다 expresses nearly doing something; 치이다 takes -ㄹ to make 치일.

8731ebd95fb3aa4b.zh: 「치인」是過去修飾形，該句型固定使用未來修飾形 -(으)ㄹ。
8731ebd95fb3aa4b.en: -은 is the past modifier ending; the pattern strictly requires the future form -(으)ㄹ.

8731ebd95fb3aa4b.zh: 「치이는」是現在修飾形，不能與 뻔했어요 搭配。
8731ebd95fb3aa4b.en: -는 is the present modifier ending, which cannot precede 뻔하다.

8731ebd95fb3aa4b.zh: 「치여」是語尾變更形式，不能直接接 뻔했어요。
8731ebd95fb3aa4b.en: 치여 is the -아/어 form and cannot connect to 뻔했어요.

885e0772d4bd80b1.en: 일요일 ends with a final consonant, requiring 이 before -잖아요.
일요일잖아요 misses the copula stem 이 required after a batchim.
885e0772d4bd80b1.zh: 「일요일잖아요」漏掉了名詞有收音時所需的「이」，文法錯誤。

885e0772d4bd80b1.en: 일요일이더라고요 conveys personal observation rather than reminding the listener of a shared fact.
885e0772d4bd80b1.zh: 「일요일이더라고요」是表達自己親身體會的發現，無法提醒對方已知事實。

885e0772d4bd80b1.en: 일요일일까요 asks a wondering question, which does not fit giving a reason.
885e0772d4bd80b1.zh: 「일요일일까요」是疑問句「會是星期天嗎？」，與後文確定閉館衝突。

8b07bc2d5e5aa636.en: 공부했어요 is the natural past tense for one's own deliberate action.
8b07bc2d5e5aa636.zh: 主詞是第一人稱「제가」陳述自身意志動作，應使用過去式「공부했어요」。

8b07bc2d5e5aa636.en: 공부하더라고요 is unnatural because -더라고요 is rarely used for one's own volitional actions.
8b07bc2d5e5aa636.zh: 「-더라고요」通常不能用於第一人稱的主動意志行為，文法不自然。

8b07bc2d5e5aa636.en: 공부하나 봐요 means seems to study, which is an inference inappropriate for oneself.
8b07bc2d5e5aa636.zh: 「공부하나 봐요」表示推測「好像在讀書」，不能用於描述自己。

8b07bc2d5e5aa636.en: 공부한대요 quotes someone else, so it cannot describe your own action.
8b07bc2d5e5aa636.zh: 「공부한대요」表示聽說「某人說要讀書」，不能用於第一人稱。

8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.en: Correct. The past tense of verbs attaches -나 보다, making 퇴근했나 봐요.
8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.zh: 正確。動詞過去式接 -나 보다，形成 퇴근했나 봐요（好像下班了）。

8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.en: 했은가 봐요 is grammatically incorrect; past tense stems take -나 보다.
8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.zh: 「했은가 봐요」是不存在的文法形式，過去式詞尾後接 -나 보다。

8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.en: 하나 봐요 is present tense, which does not fit the completed past context.
8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.zh: 「하나 봐요」是現在猜測「好像正在下班」，與燈都關了的已完成語境不合。

8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.en: 할 거예요 expresses future tense or intention, not an observational guess.
8ba7a8f9a2daf20a.zh: 「할 거예요」表示未來的推測或意志，無法表達基於現況觀察的推論。

8c28bcfc46adcc74.zh: 「-는 길에」前面固定接動詞現在式冠形詞 -는，故用 오는。
8c28bcfc46adcc74.en: 오는 is the present modifying form of 오다, properly attaching to 길에.

8c28bcfc46adcc74.zh: 「온」是過去式冠形詞，不能與「-는 길에」搭配使用。
8c28bcfc46adcc74.en: 온 is the past modifying form, which cannot be used with 길에.

8c28bcfc46adcc74.zh: 「올」是未來式冠形詞，不能與「-는 길에」搭配使用。
8c28bcfc46adcc74.en: 올 is the future modifying form, incompatible with this pattern.

8c28bcfc46adcc74.zh: 「와」是動詞詞幹或非格式體敬語，不能直接修飾名詞 길。
8c28bcfc46adcc74.en: 와 is a verb stem/ending and cannot modify the noun 길 directly.

8c614cde78635060.en: Correct. The verb stem 배우- attaches directly to -지 않으면 안 되다.
8c614cde78635060.zh: 動詞詞幹直接接否定詞尾「-지 않으면 안 되다」。

8c614cde78635060.en: 배워지 is incorrect; -지 attaches directly to the stem 배우-, not the infinitive.
8c614cde78635060.zh: 否定詞尾「-지」前應接原形詞幹，非「-어」形「배워」。

8c614cde78635060.en: 배우게 expresses purpose or result and cannot precede 않으면 안 돼요.
8c614cde78635060.zh: 「배우게」是使動或副詞形，不能接「않으면 안 돼요」。

8c614cde78635060.en: 배울지 expresses uncertainty (whether or not), which does not fit this pattern.
8c614cde78635060.zh: 「배울지」用於表示不確定疑問，無法構成必須的雙重否定。

8c64300a32ec9edc.zh: 名詞後直接接「대신(에)」，表示「代替……」。
8c64300a32ec9edc.en: N 대신 directly follows a noun to mean instead of coffee.

8c64300a32ec9edc.zh: 此處表達「代替」，名詞後接「대신」，不加受格助詞「-을」。
8c64300a32ec9edc.en: The fixed construction for instead of N is N 대신, not taking the object marker 을.

8c64300a32ec9edc.zh: 「대신」在此作副詞性結構使用，不加主格助詞「-이」。
8c64300a32ec9edc.en: 대신 functions adverbially here and does not take the subject particle 이.

8c64300a32ec9edc.zh: 「대로」表示「按照、照著」，「커피 대로」不符合句意且不自然。
8c64300a32ec9edc.en: 대로 means in accordance with or as, which does not fit the meaning instead of.

8d16a641dca7f381.zh: 主語「친구가」接時間「오늘」，否定副詞「못」修飾動詞「온다고 했어요」。
8d16a641dca7f381.en: Subject 친구가 and time 오늘 precede the negated indirect quote 못 온다고 했어요.

8db5b700f0e05ae2.zh: 原因子句「눈이 나빠져서」接賓語「안경을」與意志形「바꿔야겠어요」。
8db5b700f0e05ae2.en: The cause clause 눈이 나빠져서 precedes the object 안경을 and the intentional predicate 바꿔야겠어요.

8e22962d49a44999.en: Correct. 춥다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective, becoming 추운가 with -(으)ㄴ가 보다.
8e22962d49a44999.zh: 正確。形容詞 춥다 為 ㅂ 不規則，接 -(으)ㄴ가 보다 變為 추운가 봐요。

8e22962d49a44999.en: 춥나 uses -나, which is standard for verbs rather than adjectives.
8e22962d49a44999.zh: 「춥나」通常用於動詞，形容詞現在式應接 -(으)ㄴ가 보다。

8e22962d49a44999.en: 추워나 is an ungrammatical combination of forms.
8e22962d49a44999.zh: 「추워나」是不合文法的錯誤結合形式。

8e22962d49a44999.en: 춥는가 is incorrect; adjectives take -(으)ㄴ가, not -는가.

8eecde4f0aec2466.en: Correct. The verb stem 먹- ends in a consonant, so it takes -을 만하다 to form 먹을.
8eecde4f0aec2466.zh: 正確。動詞「먹다」有終聲尾音，需接「-을 만하다」成「먹을」。

8eecde4f0aec2466.en: The past modifier 먹은 does not fit this pattern, which requires -(으)ㄹ.
8eecde4f0aec2466.zh: 「먹은」是過去式冠形詞形，此句型規定必須接「-(으)ㄹ」。

8eecde4f0aec2466.en: The present modifier 먹는 cannot be used with the pattern -(으)ㄹ 만하다.
8eecde4f0aec2466.zh: 「먹는」是現在式冠形詞形，無法搭配句型「-(으)ㄹ 만하다」。

8eecde4f0aec2466.en: A stem ending in a consonant requires the vowel 으 before ㄹ, not 먹ㄹ.
8eecde4f0aec2466.zh: 有尾音的詞幹不能直接加「ㄹ」，必須插入母音成為「먹을」。

8eefe9729aadd916.zh: 文法為「-(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라」，「맛있다」有尾音，接「-을」。
8eefe9729aadd916.en: The pattern is -(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라; 맛있- has a final consonant, taking -을.

8eefe9729aadd916.zh: 「-는 뿐만 아니라」為錯誤形態，本句型規定接未來形冠詞「-(으)ㄹ」。
8eefe9729aadd916.en: The pattern requires the prospective modifier -(으)ㄹ, not the present modifier -는.

8eefe9729aadd916.zh: 形容詞過去冠詞形「-(으)ㄴ」不能接「뿐만 아니라」。
8eefe9729aadd916.en: The adnominal ending -(으)ㄴ is incorrect here; this construction specifically requires -(으)ㄹ.

8eefe9729aadd916.zh: 「맛있어」為非敬體詞尾形，無法修飾名詞性成分「뿐」。
8eefe9729aadd916.en: 맛있어 is an informal sentence ending, unable to modify the bound noun 뿐.

93d8cab27c9319a3.zh: 主詞「저는」接賓語「아침을」與副詞「잘」，最後接修飾「먹는」。
93d8cab27c9319a3.en: The subject 저는 takes the object 아침을 and adverb 잘, followed by the modifier 먹는 before 편이에요.

976ae55f51bdb9a6.zh: 名詞無收音時接「-(이)잖아요」形成「가수잖아요」，表示「你知道的」。
976ae55f51bdb9a6.en: When a noun ends in a vowel, attach -잖아요 directly, yielding 가수잖아요.

976ae55f51bdb9a6.zh: 名詞不能接「-ㄴ잖아요」，沒有這種語法結構。
976ae55f51bdb9a6.en: Nouns do not attach -ㄴ잖아요; this form does not exist in Korean.

976ae55f51bdb9a6.zh: 名詞不能直接加過去時態詞尾「-았-」，應為「가수였잖아요」。
976ae55f51bdb9a6.en: Nouns cannot directly take the past marker -았-; the past form would be 가수였잖아요.

976ae55f51bdb9a6.zh: 「가수」是名詞，不能直接加「-하잖아요」構成動詞形式。
976ae55f51bdb9a6.en: 가수 is a noun that does not combine with -하다 to make 가수하다.

977a7c7ed439ac37.en: 오자마자 attaches -자마자 directly to the verb stem to mean as soon as I came home.
977a7c7ed439ac37.zh: 詞尾「-자마자」直接接在詞幹오다後，表一…就…。

977a7c7ed439ac37.en: 왔자마자 is incorrect because -자마자 cannot attach to a past tense stem.
977a7c7ed439ac37.zh: 「왔자마자」錯誤結合了過去時態，-자마자前不可加過去式。

977a7c7ed439ac37.en: 오마자 is an invalid form missing the syllable 자 from the ending -자마자.
977a7c7ed439ac37.zh: 「오마자」缺少了連接詞尾中的「자」，是不存在的錯誤形式。

977a7c7ed439ac37.en: 오다가 means on the way home, implying an interruption rather than immediate succession.
977a7c7ed439ac37.zh: 「오다가」表在回家的中途中斷，與後文表達一到家就睡不符。

9833528ad9c9f5de.en: 갔던 uses -았/었던 to recall a past completed experience, fitting last year.
9833528ad9c9f5de.zh: 「갔던」用「-았/었던」回想過去已結束的特定經驗，符合句意。

9833528ad9c9f5de.en: 가는 is a present-tense modifier, conflicting with 작년에 (last year).
9833528ad9c9f5de.zh: 「가는」是現在式定語，表示「現在常去的」，與「작년」衝突。

9833528ad9c9f5de.en: 갈 indicates a future action, which cannot describe last year.
9833528ad9c9f5de.zh: 「갈」是將來式定語，表示「將要去的」，不能用在過去時間。

9833528ad9c9f5de.en: 가다 is the dictionary form and cannot directly modify the noun 식당.
9833528ad9c9f5de.zh: 「가다」是原形動詞，不能直接修飾後面的名詞「식당」。

9b13ce1f35d7bf17.en: Correct. 먹다 takes -어 before 버리다 to mean ate completely.
9b13ce1f35d7bf17.zh: 「-아/어 버리다」表示動作徹底完成，「먹다」接陰性母音「-어」。

9b13ce1f35d7bf17.en: -고 links actions in sequence and does not pair with 버리다 for this meaning.
9b13ce1f35d7bf17.zh: 「-고」表示並列或時間順序，不能與「버리다」構成該句型。

9b13ce1f35d7bf17.en: -게 means so that or in order to, not completing an action with 버리다.
9b13ce1f35d7bf17.zh: 「-게」表示目的或方式，不能與「버리다」搭配。

9b13ce1f35d7bf17.en: -(으)러 indicates going in order to do something, not this pattern.
9b13ce1f35d7bf17.zh: 「-(으)러」表示前往的目的，不符合「-아/어 버리다」句型。

9b3547aee2cde1f8.en: The adjective 좁다 has a final consonant, taking -은 대신 to express trade-off.
9b3547aee2cde1f8.zh: 形容詞「좁다」有收音，修飾後接「-은 대신」，表示交換或轉折。

9b3547aee2cde1f8.en: -는 대신 attaches to verbs, not adjectives like 좁다.
9b3547aee2cde1f8.zh: 「-는 대신」用於動詞現在式，形容詞詞幹不能加「-는」。

9b3547aee2cde1f8.en: -(으)ㄹ 대신 indicates future anticipation, whereas 좁은 reflects the present state.
9b3547aee2cde1f8.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 대신」用於表示未來推測或補償，此處描述現況應用「-은」。

9b3547aee2cde1f8.en: 좁아 is an informal verb ending and cannot directly modify 대신.
9b3547aee2cde1f8.zh: 「좁아」為非格式體口語結尾，無法直接修飾名詞「대신」。

9bad36f34e588111.zh: 接續前文「작년에」形成「비해」，再接對比主題「올해는」與主語「눈이」、副詞「많이」。
9bad36f34e588111.en: 비해 completes 작년에 비해, followed by contrast topic 올해는, subject 눈이, and adverb 많이.

9cfc9e6d324aee9e.en: Correct. The adjective 피곤하다 combines with -아/어 보이다 to become 피곤해.
9cfc9e6d324aee9e.zh: 正確。形容詞 피곤하다 接 -아/어 보이다 時，規則變為 피곤해。

9cfc9e6d324aee9e.en: 피곤하 is just the stem and lacks the required -아/어 connector.
9cfc9e6d324aee9e.zh: 「피곤하」僅是語幹，尚未與連接詞尾 -아/어 結合。

9cfc9e6d324aee9e.en: 피곤한 is the noun-modifying adjective form and cannot directly precede 보이다.
9cfc9e6d324aee9e.zh: 「피곤한」是修飾名詞的冠形詞形，不能接 보이다。

9cfc9e6d324aee9e.en: 피곤하게 is an adverb form; the standard pattern for appearance is -아/어 보이다.
9cfc9e6d324aee9e.zh: 「피곤하게」是副詞形，慣用句型為 -아/어 보이다 而非 -게 보이다。

9d1d3a1a39f1ca47.en: The verb 오다 ends in a vowel, so its reported statement form is 온다고.
9d1d3a1a39f1ca47.zh: 動詞「오다」無尾音，現在/未來陳述轉述接「-ㄴ다고 하다」，故用「온다고」。

9d1d3a1a39f1ca47.en: Verbs cannot attach -다고 directly; vowel-final verb stems require -ㄴ다고.
9d1d3a1a39f1ca47.zh: 動詞不能直接接「-다고」，無尾音動詞必須接「-ㄴ다고」。

9d1d3a1a39f1ca47.en: Vowel-final verbs take -ㄴ다고, so 오는다고 is incorrect.
9d1d3a1a39f1ca47.zh: 動詞轉述是「-ㄴ/는다고」，「오다」無收音應接「-ㄴ다고」而非「-는다고」。
過去轉述應為「왔다고」，「-라고」用於名詞或命令句型，不能接「왔라고」。

9d37c81d77db48b5.zh: 主詞「돈이」接讓步子句「많아도」，後接否定謂語「행복하지 않을」。
9d37c81d77db48b5.en: The subject 돈이 links to concession 많아도, followed by the negative predicate 행복하지 않을.

9f26b1035a29d972.zh: 「裝作…」的固定文法句型為「-(으)ㄴ/는 척하다」，過去式為「척했어요」
9f26b1035a29d972.en: The fixed pattern for pretending is -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다; past tense is 척했어요.

9f26b1035a29d972.zh: 韓語中沒有「척있다」這種假裝文法結構
9f26b1035a29d972.en: 척있다 is not a valid grammatical structure in Korean.

9f26b1035a29d972.zh: 「척되다」不是正確的文法慣用型，假裝應用動詞「하다」
9f26b1035a29d972.en: The expression uses 하다 rather than 되다; 척되었어요 does not exist.

9f26b1035a29d972.zh: 「척보다」並非假裝的句型，韓文無此搭配
9f26b1035a29d972.en: 척보다 is not a legitimate grammar expression for pretending.

a06e1d33fe85ef5a.zh: 修飾語「의사의」修飾名詞「지시에」，結合格助詞片語「따라」修飾敬語動詞「드세요」。
a06e1d33fe85ef5a.en: Modifier 의사의 qualifies 지시에, followed by 따라 to form according to instructions, leading into the imperative 드세요.

a09b1b76618c7a35.zh: 「쉬다」無收音，接「-ㄹ까 하다」表示考慮休息、尚未決定。
a09b1b76618c7a35.en: 쉬다 ends in a vowel, so adding -ㄹ까 to make 쉴까 correctly pairs with 해요.

a09b1b76618c7a35.zh: 「쉬다」沒有收音，不需添加媒介音「으」，不能寫成「쉬을까」。
a09b1b76618c7a35.en: 쉬을까 is incorrect because vowel-final stems attach -ㄹ까 directly without 으.

a09b1b76618c7a35.zh: 「-ㄹ래」不能直接與「해요」連用構成未定意向的句型。
a09b1b76618c7a35.en: 쉴래 does not pair with 해요; the pattern requires -(으)ㄹ까 하다.

a09b1b76618c7a35.zh: 「쉬었을까」是過去推測疑問形，不能與「해요」結合成考慮中的意圖。
a09b1b76618c7a35.en: 쉬었을까 expresses past speculation and does not form the plan pattern with 해요.

a0e108f88e2319e4.zh: 「가다」無收音接「-ㄹ까」，與「해요」搭配表示考慮去探望。
a0e108f88e2319e4.en: 가다 ends in a vowel, attaching -ㄹ까 to properly complete 갈까 해요.

a0e108f88e2319e4.zh: 「가다」沒有收音，不可加入「으」，此為錯誤拼寫。
a0e108f88e2319e4.en: 가을까 is incorrect because stems without a final consonant do not take 으.

a0e108f88e2319e4.zh: 「-ㄹ래」是表示意願的終結語尾，無法接「해요」構成句型。
a0e108f88e2319e4.en: 갈래 is a sentence-ending form and cannot combine with 해요.

a0e108f88e2319e4.zh: 「갔을까」為過去推測型態，不適用於考慮未來假期的計畫。
a0e108f88e2319e4.en: 갔을까 is past speculative and cannot describe a future tentative plan with 해요.

a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.zh: 「에 따라」接在名詞後，表示「隨著…而有所不同」，符合句意。
a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.en: 에 따라 attaches to a noun to express that something varies depending on it.

a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.zh: 「에 따르고」是並列連接形式，在此處無法修飾後方的「달라요」。
a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.en: 에 따르고 is a connective clause ending and does not naturally modify 달라요.

a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.zh: 「에 비해」表示「比起…」，用於兩者比較，不合句意。
a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.en: 에 비해 means compared to and indicates comparison rather than variation.

a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.zh: 「대신」表示「代替」或「反而」，與依季節變化的句意不符。
a1749f1ea4d0aa9f.en: 대신 means instead of, which does not fit the meaning of varying with seasons.

a228a91fc3b54871.en: Nouns attach directly to 뿐만 아니라 to express not only N, but also.
a228a91fc3b54871.zh: 名詞後面直接連接「뿐만 아니라」，表示「不僅…而且…」。

a228a91fc3b54871.en: 의 뿐만 아니라 unnecessarily adds the genitive particle 의; nouns attach directly to 뿐.
a228a91fc3b54871.zh: 「의 뿐만 아니라」多加了屬格助詞「의」，名詞應直接接「뿐만 아니라」。

a228a91fc3b54871.en: 에 비해 means compared with, which contradicts the additive meaning of the sentence.
a228a91fc3b54871.zh: 「에 비해」表示「和…相比」，與後文「外國也很受歡迎」的並列語意不合。

a228a91fc3b54871.en: 대신 means instead of, which does not make sense in this context.
a228a91fc3b54871.zh: 「대신」表示「代替」，不符合「國內受歡迎，國外也很受歡迎」的意思。

a46143a9a384c07a.zh: 時間狀語「여행 가기 전에」在先，受詞「호텔을」置於動詞「예약해」前。
a46143a9a384c07a.en: The time phrase 여행 가기 전에 leads, followed by object 호텔을 which objects verb 예약해 before 두세요.

a4b9c6849de5a2b1.en: Correct. -(으)세요 forms a polite imperative matching the context.
a4b9c6849de5a2b1.zh: 「-(으)세요」表示禮貌的祈使句，符合句意「請讓它開著」。

a4b9c6849de5a2b1.en: -(으)러 means in order to and cannot end a standalone sentence.
a4b9c6849de5a2b1.zh: 「-(으)러」表示目的，後面需接移動動詞，不能作句尾。

a4b9c6849de5a2b1.en: -다가 indicates an interrupted action and is not a sentence-ending form.
a4b9c6849de5a2b1.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中斷轉換，不能作終結詞尾。

a4b9c6849de5a2b1.en: -느라고 expresses reason for a negative result and cannot finish the sentence.
a4b9c6849de5a2b1.zh: 「-느라고」表示因某動作而產生負面結果，不能作句尾結尾。

a5cc09008704cbfb.zh: 「가는」修飾「길에」構成在回家途中，接著受詞「꽃을」與動詞「샀어요」。
a5cc09008704cbfb.en: 가는 modifies 길에 to make on the way, followed by object 꽃을 and verb 샀어요.

a6121b1bb75e3db5.zh: 副詞 너무 修飾 배가 고파서 表原因，再接動詞 쓰러질 與 뻔했어요 結合。
a6121b1bb75e3db5.en: 너무 배가 고파서 expresses the extreme cause, correctly leading to 쓰러질 before 뻔했어요.

a716d2f2cf7e0da3.zh: 「-거든요」接在詞幹後，向對方說明自己得早走的理由「有約會」。
a716d2f2cf7e0da3.en: Attach -거든요 to provide background information or explain the reason to the listener.

a716d2f2cf7e0da3.zh: 「-더라고요」是表達回想自己親眼觀察到的情況，不能用來說明個人安排的理由。
a716d2f2cf7e0da3.en: The ending -더라고요 reports an observed recollection, not explaining the reason for one's own plans.

a716d2f2cf7e0da3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」表達主觀意願或打算，無法作為解釋早走原因的理由句尾。
a716d2f2cf7e0da3.en: The ending -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses personal volition and does not serve as an explanatory justification.

a716d2f2cf7e0da3.zh: 「-자고요」是提議的引用句尾，與說明原因的情境不符。
a716d2f2cf7e0da3.en: The ending -자고요 is a suggestive quotation and cannot explain the reason for leaving early.

a917fdbd67d6c1f3.zh: 形容詞「춥다」為 ㅂ 不規則，接「-(으)ㄴ가 보다」時變成「추운가」
a917fdbd67d6c1f3.en: Adjective 춥다 has an irregular ㅂ, changing to 추운가 before -(으)ㄴ가 보다.

a917fdbd67d6c1f3.zh: 「춥다」接母音開頭詞尾時 ㅂ 會轉變為 우，不會保留為「춥은가」
a917fdbd67d6c1f3.en: The final ㅂ in 춥다 changes to 우 before a vowel, so 춥은가 is incorrect.

a917fdbd67d6c1f3.zh: 「추워나」不存在；形容詞的推測標準說法是「추운가 봐요」。
a917fdbd67d6c1f3.en: 추워나 does not exist; the standard guess with an adjective is 추운가 봐요.

a917fdbd67d6c1f3.zh: 形容詞現在式推測應接「-(으)ㄴ가 보다」，不能接「-는가」
a917fdbd67d6c1f3.en: Adjectives take -(으)ㄴ가 보다 for present guesses, not -는가.

a9868345755e298b.en: Correct. The consonant-ending stem 늦다 attaches -을 텐데요 to form 늦을 텐데요.
a9868345755e298b.zh: 正確。形容詞 늦다 有收音，接 -을 텐데요 成為 늦을 텐데요。

a9868345755e298b.en: 늦은 is a modifying form and cannot attach directly to 텐데요.
a9868345755e298b.zh: 「늦은」是過去/形容詞冠形詞，不能與推測的 텐데요 結合。

a9868345755e298b.en: 늦는 is a present-modifying suffix and does not form 텐데요.
a9868345755e298b.zh: 「늦는」是動詞冠形詞尾，不適用於表示推測的 텐데요。

a9868345755e298b.en: 늦어 cannot connect to the bound noun 터 in 텐데요.
a9868345755e298b.zh: 「늦어」為語幹接 -어 形態，無法直接修飾依存名詞 터(텐데)。

aaaa55e7e157dccc.en: With 같이 (together), this reports a suggestion or proposal, requiring -자고 하다.
aaaa55e7e157dccc.zh: 句中有「같이（一起）」，表示轉述提議，接「-자고 하다」，故選「보자고」。

aaaa55e7e157dccc.en: 보라고 reports a command (told someone to watch), which clashes with 같이.
aaaa55e7e157dccc.zh: 「보라고」是引用命令句「-(으)라고」，意思會變成叫別人去看電影。

aaaa55e7e157dccc.en: 보냐고 reports a question (asked if one is watching), not a suggestion.
aaaa55e7e157dccc.zh: 「보냐고」是引用疑問句「-냐고」，意思會變成詢問是否看電影。

aaaa55e7e157dccc.en: 본다고 reports a statement (said that he is watching), not a joint suggestion.
aaaa55e7e157dccc.zh: 「본다고」是引用陳述句「-ㄴ다고」，意思會變成弟弟說他自己要看電影。

aac22754b05c016d.zh: 「-아/어 오다」表示持續至今，모으다 變格為 모아 오다。
aac22754b05c016d.en: Correct. -아/어 오다 indicates an action continuing up to now; 모으다 conjugates to 모아.

aac22754b05c016d.zh: 「모으」是未經音變的詞幹，不能直接連接 왔어요。
aac22754b05c016d.en: 모으 is just the raw verb stem and cannot attach to 왔어요 without -아/어.

aac22754b05c016d.zh: 「모고」為錯誤變位形式，且連接詞尾 -고 不能用於此句型。
aac22754b05c016d.en: 모고 is an incorrect form; moreover, -고 does not form this continuous aspect.

aac22754b05c016d.zh: 「모은」是過去冠形詞形，只能修飾後面的名詞。
aac22754b05c016d.en: -은 is a noun-modifying modifier ending, not the connector for -아/어 오다.

abee81c53e05003f.zh: 形容詞「춥다」為 ㅂ 不規則，修飾名詞時應變化為「추운」。
abee81c53e05003f.en: The adjective 춥다 is a ㅂ-irregular, changing to 추운 when modifying a noun.

abee81c53e05003f.zh: 「-는 편이다」用於動詞現在式，形容詞「춥다」不能接「-는」。
abee81c53e05003f.en: -는 is used with action verbs in the present tense, not adjectives like 춥다.

abee81c53e05003f.zh: 「춥다」遇到母音時 ㅂ 會變為 우，因此不會是「춥은」。
abee81c53e05003f.en: Because 춥다 is a ㅂ-irregular verb, ㅂ changes to 우 before a vowel, not 춥은.

abee81c53e05003f.zh: 「추워」是非格式體非敬語終結形，不能直接修飾「편이다」。
abee81c53e05003f.en: 추워 is an informal ending and cannot directly modify the noun 편.

ac125b8f84daeded.zh: 主語「그 식당은」接讓步轉折「맛있기는 한데」，後接副詞「너무」與「비싸요」。
ac125b8f84daeded.en: Topic 그 식당은 takes concession 맛있기는 한데, followed by adverb 너무 and predicate 비싸요.

acd1b6e3c695b53d.zh: 「듣다」為 ㄷ 不規則動詞，過去定語形接「-(으)ㄴ」變成「들은」
acd1b6e3c695b53d.en: The verb 듣다 is irregular (ㄷ becomes ㄹ before vowels), yielding 들은 with -(으)ㄴ.

acd1b6e3c695b53d.zh: 「듣다」遇母音詞尾時收音 ㄷ 應變為 ㄹ，不會是「듣은」
acd1b6e3c695b53d.en: Irregular ㄷ must change to ㄹ before a vowel; 듣은 is ungrammatical.

acd1b6e3c695b53d.zh: 動詞現在式接「-는」時 ㄷ 不會變成 ㄹ，正確現在式應為「듣는」
acd1b6e3c695b53d.en: Before consonant -는, ㄷ remains unchanged (듣는); 들는 is incorrect.

acd1b6e3c695b53d.zh: 「들」缺少定語形詞尾「-은」，無法修飾名詞「척」
acd1b6e3c695b53d.en: The bare stem 들 lacks the required noun-modifying ending -(으)ㄴ.

aec4f83faddc4920.zh: 主詞 그 사람은 接比較對象 나이보다，再接形容詞幹 젊어 連接句尾。
aec4f83faddc4920.en: Subject 그 사람은 is followed by comparison 나이보다, then 젊어 combining with 보여요.

af568f20025a2a50.en: 갔다가 correctly expresses going to the convenience store and then coming back.
af568f20025a2a50.zh: 「갔다가」表示去便利商店之後再回來，符合前後文意。

af568f20025a2a50.en: 가다가 means on the way to somewhere, interrupting the movement before arriving.
af568f20025a2a50.zh: 「가다가」表示在去便利商店的中途轉做別的事，不合文意。

af568f20025a2a50.en: 가었다가 is an incorrect spelling; 가다 combines with -았/었다가 to form 갔다가.
af568f20025a2a50.zh: 「가었다가」拼寫錯誤，가다結合過去形應縮寫為갔다가。

af568f20025a2a50.en: 가면서 means while going, implying doing two conflicting directional actions simultaneously.
af568f20025a2a50.zh: 「가면서」表示一邊去一邊回來，兩動作方向相反無法同時進行。

afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 텐데」表示推測背景，無收音的「막히다」接「막힐」。
afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.en: 막히다 ends in a vowel, so it correctly takes -(으)ㄹ to become 막힐.

afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.zh: 「막히는」是動詞現在式冠形詞形，不能接表示推測的「텐데」。
afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.en: 막히는 is a present adnominal form and cannot attach to 텐데 for a guess.

afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.zh: 「막힌」是過去冠形詞形，此處為對未來狀況的推測，故不合。
afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.en: 막힌 is past tense, whereas this sentence guesses a future or general situation.

afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.zh: 「막혀」為非格式體口語結尾，不能直接修飾依賴名詞「터(텐데)」。
afd5f21d7e1e5e1b.en: 막혀 is an informal sentence ending and cannot modify the noun 터.

b348d6f31b8c2091.en: -(으)려면 means if you intend/want to, setting a condition for advice or directions.
b348d6f31b8c2091.zh: 「-(으)려면」是「-(으)려고 하면」的縮略，表示「若想…就要…」。

b348d6f31b8c2091.en: -면서 means while doing, which would mean taking Line 4 while simultaneously going.
b348d6f31b8c2091.zh: 「-면서」表示同時做兩件事，語意變成「邊去明洞邊搭4號線」。

b348d6f31b8c2091.en: -(으)려고 cannot be followed by imperative sentences like -세요.
-자마자 means as soon as, which does not fit giving route directions.
b348d6f31b8c2091.zh: 「-자마자」表示「一…就…」，後面接命令句在語義上不通。

b35a04a2c4da626f.zh: 目的地「집에」接「가는 길에」形成在回家途中，再接「편의점에 들렀어요」。
b35a04a2c4da626f.en: 집에 leads to 가는 길에 meaning on the way home, followed by destination 편의점에.

b3e68103e77b8a43.zh: 正解。맛있다 的 -아/어 形為 맛있어，接 보이다 表示「看起來好吃」。
b3e68103e77b8a43.en: Correct. 맛있- takes -어 to combine with 보이다 into 맛있어 보이다.

b3e68103e77b8a43.zh: 缺少連接母音 -어-，詞幹不能直接加 보이다。
b3e68103e77b8a43.en: Lacks the connecting vowel -어-; the bare stem cannot directly attach to 보이다.

b3e68103e77b8a43.zh: 冠形詞形（修飾名詞用），無法與補助動詞 보이다 搭配。
b3e68103e77b8a43.en: This is a noun-modifying form, not compatible with the auxiliary 보이다.

b3e68103e77b8a43.zh: 表示「因為好吃」，是因果連接詞尾，非「看起來…」之意。
b3e68103e77b8a43.en: Means because it is delicious; expresses reason instead of appearance.

b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.en: 닫았을걸요 correctly combines past tense with -(으)ㄹ걸요 to guess that it has probably already closed.
b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.zh: 「닫았을걸요」結合過去式與推測尾「-(으)ㄹ걸요」，符合語意。

b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.en: 닫았을래요 incorrectly attaches the intentional ending -(으)ㄹ래요 to a past stem.
b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.zh: 「닫았을래요」將過去式與意願尾「-(으)ㄹ래요」混合，文法錯誤。

b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.en: 닫았자고요 is an ungrammatical form combining past tense with a proposal ending.
b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.zh: 「닫았자고요」是不自然的提議形態，無法用於陳述推測。
