b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.en: 닫았으세요 incorrectly attempts to attach an honorific ending to a past verb form.
b3f7d09c2a5b2f71.zh: 「닫았으세요」是將過去式與敬語命令/陳述混用的錯誤形態。

b42628889f1708bd.zh: 受詞「책을」接動詞「읽다가」，連接中斷後發生的主謂結構「잠이 들었어요」。
b42628889f1708bd.en: 책을 is the object of 읽다가, which uses the interruptive suffix 다가 before the clause 잠이 들었어요.

b453c76e54564aa4.zh: 「자르다」無收音接「-ㄹ까」，搭配「했는데」表示原本考慮剪短。
b453c76e54564aa4.en: 자르다 ends in a vowel, forming 자를까 to complete the pattern with 했는데.
잘을까 is ungrammatical; the stem 자르- attaches -ㄹ까 directly.

b453c76e54564aa4.zh: 「-ㄹ래」為意志終結語尾，不能與「했는데」結合成過去的打算。
b453c76e54564aa4.en: 자를래 cannot combine with 했는데 to convey a past contemplation.

b453c76e54564aa4.zh: 「잘랐을까」為過去推測疑問，不符合「曾考慮剪短但…」的語意。
b453c76e54564aa4.en: 잘랐을까 expresses past conjecture and does not mean I was thinking of cutting.

b50bca27dbe7d403.en: The doctor is giving an instruction, which is reported using -(으)라고 하다.
b50bca27dbe7d403.zh: 醫生要求患者好好休息是命令/囑咐，轉述接「-(으)라고」，無收音接「쉬라고」。

b50bca27dbe7d403.en: 쉬자고 reports a suggestion (suggested resting together), which does not fit a doctor-patient instruction.
b50bca27dbe7d403.zh: 「쉬자고」是轉述提議「-자고」，意思會變成醫生提議「我們一起休息吧」。

b50bca27dbe7d403.en: 쉬냐고 reports a question (asked whether one rests), not medical advice.
b50bca27dbe7d403.zh: 「쉬냐고」是轉述疑問句「-냐고」，意思會變成醫生詢問「有沒有休息」。

b50bca27dbe7d403.en: 쉰다고 reports a statement (said that they are resting), not doctor advice.
b50bca27dbe7d403.zh: 「쉰다고」是轉述陳述句「-ㄴ다고」，意思會變成醫生說他自己要休息。

b53a5842a69d296e.en: 닫히다 is the passive form of 닫다, meaning the door closed.
b53a5842a69d296e.zh: 「닫다」的被動形為「닫히다」，表示門受到風吹而關上。

b53a5842a69d296e.en: 닫았어요 is active (closed something), requiring an agent, not 문이.
b53a5842a69d296e.zh: 「닫았어요」為主動形，主詞應為關門的人，而非「문이」。

b53a5842a69d296e.en: 닫겼어요 is incorrect; 닫다 uses the passive suffix -히-, not -기-.
닫렸어요 is incorrect; 닫다 uses the passive suffix -히-, not -리-.

b53f39a92d2c178f.en: Correct. Verb stems take -다가 to show an action in progress being interrupted or followed by another.
b53f39a92d2c178f.zh: 正確。動詞詞幹接「-다가」表示動作途中轉移到另一事件。

b53f39a92d2c178f.en: 갔다가 implies having arrived or gone first, whereas 가다가 shows meeting while on the way.
b53f39a92d2c178f.zh: 「갔다가」表示已經去完某地之後，在此指「路上遇到」，應接現在式。

b53f39a92d2c178f.en: 가면서도 means 'even while going', expressing concession rather than an interruption.
b53f39a92d2c178f.zh: 「가면서도」表示「一邊去卻還…」，表讓步對比，與句意不符。

b53f39a92d2c178f.en: 가려고 indicates intention ('in order to go'), which does not fit encountering someone on the way.
b53f39a92d2c178f.zh: 「가려고」表示「為了要去…」的目的，不符情境。

b5db9499a101f65e.en: 에 비해 correctly forms the comparison construction meaning compared with.
b5db9499a101f65e.zh: 「에 비해」表示「和…相比」，是固定搭配的比較句型。

b5db9499a101f65e.en: 을 비해 uses the wrong particle; the standard of comparison requires 에, not 을.
b5db9499a101f65e.zh: 「을 비해」助詞搭配錯誤，比較基準的名詞後應接「에」。

b5db9499a101f65e.en: 대신 means instead of or in place of, which does not fit a comparison.
b5db9499a101f65e.zh: 「대신」表示「代替」或「反而」，不符合句中比較的語意。

b5db9499a101f65e.en: 에 따라 means depending on or according to, not compared with.
b5db9499a101f65e.zh: 「에 따라」表示「隨著…」或「根據…」，不符合句意。

b615390ae8d40ac1.en: Correct. The verb 오다 ends in a vowel, attaching -(으)ㄹ지도 to form 올지도.
b615390ae8d40ac1.zh: 正確。動詞 오다 無收音，接 -(으)ㄹ지도 成為 올지도。

b615390ae8d40ac1.en: 오을지도 is incorrect because vowel-final stems attach -ㄹ지도, not -을지도.
b615390ae8d40ac1.zh: 「오을지도」是錯誤形態，無收音詞幹應接 -ㄹ지도。

b615390ae8d40ac1.en: 온지도 relates to time elapsed since an action, not possibility.
b615390ae8d40ac1.zh: 「온지도」通常用於時間間隔結構 -(으)ㄴ 지，非不確定推測。

b615390ae8d40ac1.en: 오는지도 introduces an embedded question whether it comes, not a possibility.
b615390ae8d40ac1.zh: 「오는지도」表示是否正在來的不確定間接問句，不符合此處推測語氣。

b6494e317c43ef79.zh: 「-자마자」接在原形詞幹後，ㄷ不規則動詞「듣다」保留ㄷ接「자마자」。
b6494e317c43ef79.en: 자마자 attaches directly to the dictionary stem 듣-, so 듣자마자 is the correct form.

b6494e317c43ef79.zh: ㄷ不規則只在母音前變成ㄹ；「-자마자」以子音開頭，所以是「듣자마자」，不是「들자마자」。
b6494e317c43ef79.en: ㄷ becomes ㄹ only before a vowel; -자마자 starts with a consonant, so it is 듣자마자, not 들자마자.
자마자 cannot combine with past-tense inflections, so 들었자마자 is ungrammatical.

b6494e317c43ef79.zh: 「-자마자」直接接詞幹，不需要加介音「-으-」，形態錯誤。
b6494e317c43ef79.en: 자마자 attaches directly to the stem without an epenthetic 으, making 들으자마자 wrong.

b6ecba6524cf53ca.zh: 「녹다」的陰性母音接「-아/어 버렸어요」，表示冰淇淋融化完了的遺憾。
b6ecba6524cf53ca.en: 녹아 combines with -아 버렸어요 to express completion with regret in the past.
-고 cannot combine with 버리다; the pattern requires -아/어.

b6ecba6524cf53ca.zh: 「-ㄹ래요」表示說話者的意願，不能用於冰淇淋融化的自然現象。
b6ecba6524cf53ca.en: -ㄹ래요 indicates the speaker's intention, which cannot apply to ice cream melting.

b6ecba6524cf53ca.zh: 「-게 버리다」文法錯誤，補助動詞「버리다」不能接「-게」。
b6ecba6524cf53ca.en: -게 버렸어요 is ungrammatical; the auxiliary verb 버리다 requires the -아/어 form.

b71ce9313fb4444b.en: Consonant-ending nouns use -이래요 in casual reported speech (short for -이라고 해요).
b71ce9313fb4444b.zh: 名詞「형」有尾音，口語轉述縮略型接「-이래요」（來自 -(이)라고 해요）。

b71ce9313fb4444b.en: Reported speech for nouns shortens from -(이)라고 해요 to -(이)래요, not -이대요.
b71ce9313fb4444b.zh: 名詞轉述縮略來自「-(이)라고 해요」，縮略為「-(이)래요」而非「-이대요」。

b71ce9313fb4444b.en: 형인대요 uses the backgrounding ending -(으)ㄴ대요, not the hearsay ending -래요.
b71ce9313fb4444b.zh: 「-ㄴ/은/인대요」是表示背景或反駁的語尾，並非轉述「聽說」的意思。

b71ce9313fb4444b.en: Because 형 ends in a consonant, it requires the marker 이, becoming 형이래요.
b71ce9313fb4444b.zh: 名詞「형」有尾音，必須加上助詞「이」形成「형이래요」，不能直接接「-래요」。

b8c3a4da41fc6151.zh: 慣用語型為「-(으)ㄴ/는 척하다」，過去式以「했어요」結尾
b8c3a4da41fc6151.en: The construction is -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다, which conjugates to 했어요 in the past.

b8c3a4da41fc6151.zh: 「척되다」為不自然且錯誤的搭配，韓語固定搭配「하다」
b8c3a4da41fc6151.en: The auxiliary verb with 척 is 하다, not 되다.

b8c3a4da41fc6151.zh: 「척보다」不是表達「假裝」的文法，意思完全不通
b8c3a4da41fc6151.en: 척보다 is not an expression for pretending and makes no sense here.

b8c3a4da41fc6151.zh: 「척있다」不存在，表示裝模作樣須使用動詞「하다」
b8c3a4da41fc6151.en: 척 cannot combine with 있다 to mean pretending.

b8fc5fddcdb98376.zh: 主詞「기차가」搭配副詞「벌써」，動詞「떠나」與補助動詞「버렸어요」結合在句尾。
b8fc5fddcdb98376.en: Subject 기차가 and adverb 벌써 precede the predicate 떠나 followed by the auxiliary 버렸어요.

bae3413434d480e2.zh: 副詞「그러니까」接主語「제가」，連同引用語「조심하라고」與謂語「했잖아요」。
bae3413434d480e2.en: 그러니까 connects to subject 제가, indirect command 조심하라고, and ends with reminder 했잖아요.

be03aa80c76ba634.zh: 「갔다가」表示去了朋友家並停留後，再回來，符合前後相反的移動。
be03aa80c76ba634.en: 갔다가 shows that one went to the friend's house and completed the stay before returning.

be03aa80c76ba634.zh: 「가다가」表示在前往朋友家的路途中折返，而不是去過之後回來。
be03aa80c76ba634.en: 가다가 implies turning back while on the way to the friend's house, not after visiting.

be03aa80c76ba634.zh: 「-고서도」表示「即使…也」，帶有轉折或驚訝語氣，語意不合。
be03aa80c76ba634.en: 고서도 means even after doing so, showing unexpected contrast, which does not fit here.

be03aa80c76ba634.zh: 「-느라고」表示因為忙於去朋友家而導致消極結果，文意不符。
be03aa80c76ba634.en: 느라고 expresses a negative consequence caused by doing an action, which does not apply here.

be39d12da0f7c6de.en: 바쁘다 is an ㅡ-irregular adjective; ㅡ drops and takes -아도 because of the preceding ㅏ.
be39d12da0f7c6de.zh: 「바쁘다」為ㅡ不規則，前字為陽性元音ㅏ，故脫落後作「바빠도」。

be39d12da0f7c6de.en: The vowel ㅡ must drop before vowel suffixes, making 바쁘도 incorrect.
be39d12da0f7c6de.zh: 「ㅡ」遇元音接尾詞時應脫落，「바쁘도」為錯誤形態。

be39d12da0f7c6de.en: The vowel in the first syllable is ㅏ, so it requires -아도, not -어도.
be39d12da0f7c6de.zh: 「바쁘다」的前一音節為陽性元音ㅏ，應接「-아도」而非「어」。

be39d12da0f7c6de.en: The vowel ㅡ must drop rather than stay before 아, so 바쁘아도 is incorrect.
be39d12da0f7c6de.zh: 詞幹中的元音「ㅡ」應脫落，不可保留並寫成「바쁘아도」。

c0b9bd83b37961a9.en: Correct. -지 않으면 안 되다 is a double negative meaning must or have no choice.
c0b9bd83b37961a9.zh: 雙重否定句型「-지 않으면 안 되다」表示必須。

c0b9bd83b37961a9.en: 돼요 would mean it is okay not to submit, contradicting the required meaning.
c0b9bd83b37961a9.zh: 「돼요」會變成「如果不交也可以」，與原意相反且不合句型。

c0b9bd83b37961a9.en: 좋아요 would mean it is good if you do not submit, changing the meaning.
c0b9bd83b37961a9.zh: 「좋아요」表示「不交的話很好」，不是表達「必須」的句型。

c0b9bd83b37961a9.en: 괜찮아요 would mean it is fine not to submit, reversing the obligation.
c0b9bd83b37961a9.zh: 「괜찮아요」表示「不交也沒關係」，語意與「必須」完全相反。

c1d8d101bcd44ea8.zh: 「아프다」為形容詞，無收音接「-ㄴ 척하다」表示裝作生病
c1d8d101bcd44ea8.en: Adjective 아프다 ends in a vowel, so it takes -ㄴ 척하다 to mean pretend to be sick.

c1d8d101bcd44ea8.zh: 「-는 척하다」用於動詞現在式，形容詞不能接「-는」
c1d8d101bcd44ea8.en: -는 척하다 is used with verbs; adjectives cannot take -는.

c1d8d101bcd44ea8.zh: 「척하다」前面用現在或過去的冠形詞形，形容詞要說「아픈 척」，不說「아플 척」。
c1d8d101bcd44ea8.en: 척하다 follows a present or past modifier; with an adjective it is 아픈 척, not 아플 척.

c1d8d101bcd44ea8.zh: 「척하다」前必須使用冠形詞形（定語形），不能直接接非正式終結形「아파」
c1d8d101bcd44ea8.en: 척하다 requires a modifier form, so the bare stem form 아파 is ungrammatical.

c214b48ccb4e2e06.zh: 主詞 여름 방학이 後接副詞 거의 다，最後接動詞語幹 끝나 與 가요 結合。
c214b48ccb4e2e06.en: The subject 여름 방학이 is followed by adverbs 거의 다, ending with 끝나 before auxiliary 가요.

c251d795e92ebf9d.en: The passive form of 밟다 is created by adding the affix -히-, forming 밟히다.

c251d795e92ebf9d.zh: 「밟았어요」為主動形「踩了」，這裡表示自己的腳被別人踩到。
c251d795e92ebf9d.en: 밟았어요 is active (stepped on), but here your foot was stepped on by someone else.

c251d795e92ebf9d.zh: 韓語中沒有「-기-」加在「밟다」上的被動形式「밟기다」。
c251d795e92ebf9d.en: The passive suffix for 밟다 is -히-, not -기-, making 밟겼어요 non-existent.

c251d795e92ebf9d.zh: 「밟다」不能接被動後綴「-리-」，正確後綴為「-히-」。
c251d795e92ebf9d.en: The passive suffix -리- cannot attach to 밟다; only -히- is correct.

c35a9c9523231187.en: Reported speech for nouns takes -(이)라고 하다; 의사 ends in a vowel, so 의사라고 is correct.
c35a9c9523231187.zh: 名詞轉述使用「-(이)라고 하다」，「의사」無尾音接「의사라고」。

c35a9c9523231187.en: Nouns cannot directly take -다고; they must use -(이)라고 instead.
c35a9c9523231187.zh: 名詞間接引用陳述時不可直接接「-다고」，必須使用「-(이)라고」。

c35a9c9523231187.en: -는다고 is for consonant-ending verbs, not nouns like 의사.
c35a9c9523231187.zh: 「-는다고」是用於有收音的動詞，不能接在名詞「의사」之後。

c35a9c9523231187.en: -ㄴ다고 is for vowel-ending verbs; nouns use -(이)라고.
c35a9c9523231187.zh: 「-ㄴ다고」是用於無收音的動詞，名詞轉述不能用「-ㄴ다고」。

c3886ae3b8a11ddd.zh: 正解。행복하다 變為 행복해 後接 보이다，意為「看起來幸福」。
c3886ae3b8a11ddd.en: Correct. 행복하다 changes to 행복해 to attach to 보이다, meaning looks happy.

c3886ae3b8a11ddd.zh: 未接母音連接詞 -아/어，詞幹無法直接接 보이다。
c3886ae3b8a11ddd.en: The bare stem cannot connect directly to 보이다 without -아/어.

c3886ae3b8a11ddd.zh: 冠形詞形用以修飾後方名詞，後面不可直接接 보이다。
c3886ae3b8a11ddd.en: Modifier form used before nouns, cannot directly precede the verb 보이다.

c3886ae3b8a11ddd.zh: 表示原因「因為幸福」，無法與補助動詞 보이다 構成句型。
c3886ae3b8a11ddd.en: Causal ending meaning because you are happy, which does not fit the pattern.

c4e49bd36824f9a2.en: 닫았더라고요 conveys a past state you personally witnessed upon arriving.
c4e49bd36824f9a2.zh: 「닫았더라고요」用於轉述親自看到「店已經關門」的過去事實。

c4e49bd36824f9a2.en: 닫을까요 asks a question or suggestion, not reporting what you saw.
c4e49bd36824f9a2.zh: 「닫을까요」表示詢問對方意見「要關嗎？」，與回顧事實無關。

c4e49bd36824f9a2.en: 닫으세요 is an imperative meaning please close, unfitting here.
c4e49bd36824f9a2.zh: 「닫으세요」是要求對方「請關門」的命令句，文意不合。

c4e49bd36824f9a2.en: 닫읍시다 is a proposal meaning let us close, unfitting here.
c4e49bd36824f9a2.zh: 「닫읍시다」是「我們關門吧」的提議句，無法陳述過去事實。

c59f247b77b8884f.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ지도 모르다」表示可能、說不定，符合句意。
c59f247b77b8884f.en: -(으)ㄹ지도 모르다 expresses a possibility meaning might or may.

c59f247b77b8884f.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ지 알다」表示知道某事，且此句型不搭配 도。
c59f247b77b8884f.en: -(으)ㄹ지 알다 means knowing how or whether to do something, not might.

c59f247b77b8884f.zh: 韓語中沒有「-(으)ㄹ지도 없다」這種推測句型用法。
c59f247b77b8884f.en: -(으)ㄹ지도 없다 is not an existing grammatical construction.

c59f247b77b8884f.zh: 「-아/어도 되다」表示可以，不能接在「-ㄹ지」之後。
c59f247b77b8884f.en: -아/어도 되다 expresses permission and does not follow -(으)ㄹ지.

c6d950b796d687ba.zh: 主格「제가」接過去回想修飾語「읽던」，修飾賓語「책을」後接謂語「가져갔어요」。
c6d950b796d687ba.en: Subject 제가 and retrospective modifier 읽던 qualify 책을, followed by the predicate 가져갔어요.

c6e761a5fd3ab2a4.zh: 主題「그 가게는」在首，接時間「오늘」與賓語「문을」，最後接推測「닫았을지도」。
c6e761a5fd3ab2a4.en: Topic 그 가게는 precedes time 오늘, object 문을, and past guess 닫았을지도 before 몰라요.

c80105ab24282bb1.zh: 正解。어리다 加上 -어 變為 어려，接 보이다 表「看起來年輕」。
c80105ab24282bb1.en: Correct. 어리다 combines with -어 to form 어려, which attaches to 보이다.

c80105ab24282bb1.zh: 未進行 -아/어 結合，詞幹 어리- 不能直接連用 보이다。
c80105ab24282bb1.en: The bare stem cannot connect to 보이다 without conjugating to -아/어.

c80105ab24282bb1.zh: 冠形詞形用於修飾名詞，不接補助動詞 보이다。
c80105ab24282bb1.en: This is a noun-modifying form, inappropriate before the auxiliary verb 보이다.

c80105ab24282bb1.zh: 表示「因為年幼」，是因果關係詞尾，不合文法句型。
c80105ab24282bb1.en: Means because one is young; a causal connective rather than the appearance pattern.

c832dbd785520c63.zh: 形容詞「부끄럽다」為 ㅂ 不規則，接「-(으)ㄴ가 보다」變為「부끄러운가」
c832dbd785520c63.en: Adjective 부끄럽다 drops ㅂ to become 부끄러운가 with -(으)ㄴ가 보다.

c832dbd785520c63.zh: 「부끄럽다」遇母音詞尾時 ㅂ 會變為 우，不能直接接「-은가」
c832dbd785520c63.en: The irregular ㅂ changes to 우 before vowels; 부끄럽은가 is not formed.

c832dbd785520c63.zh: 「부끄러운나」不存在；形容詞的推測標準說法是「부끄러운가 봐요」。
c832dbd785520c63.en: 부끄러운나 does not exist; the standard guess with an adjective is 부끄러운가 봐요.

c832dbd785520c63.zh: 推測句型是「-(으)ㄴ가 보다」，不存在「-어 가 보다」這種接法
c832dbd785520c63.en: The grammar pattern is -(으)ㄴ가 보다; 부끄러워가 is an impossible form.

c9e0086b6e263628.zh: 動詞現在式搭配「-는 편이다」，「자다」接「자는」。
c9e0086b6e263628.en: Action verbs in the present take -는 편이다, so 자다 becomes 자는.

c9e0086b6e263628.zh: 「-ㄴ 편이다」用於動詞過去式或形容詞，此處指一般習慣。
c9e0086b6e263628.en: The form 잔 indicates past tense for verbs, but this sentence describes a habitual tendency.

c9e0086b6e263628.zh: 「-ㄹ 편이다」為未來推測形，不能與「편이다」搭配。
c9e0086b6e263628.en: The prospective ending -ㄹ does not combine with 편이다.

c9e0086b6e263628.zh: 語幹「자」不能直接修飾名詞性質的「편」。
c9e0086b6e263628.en: The raw verb stem 자 cannot directly modify 편 without a modifier suffix.

ca0996a137bec780.zh: 主詞「그는」接賓語「아무것도」，動詞「모르다」接「-는 척했어요」表示裝作不知道
ca0996a137bec780.en: Subject 그는 and object 아무것도 lead into verb 모르다 with the pattern -는 척했어요.

cc41586615bf6f07.en: Correct. With stem vowel ㅣ, adding -어 보이다 correctly forms 맛있어 보여요.
cc41586615bf6f07.zh: 正確。語幹母音為 ㅣ，加上 -어 보이다 形成 맛있어 보여요。

cc41586615bf6f07.en: 맛있 is merely the verb stem and needs the connective -어 before 보이다.
cc41586615bf6f07.zh: 「맛있」只是語幹，必須接續詞尾 -어 才能接 보이다。

cc41586615bf6f07.en: 맛있는 is a noun-modifying form, which cannot connect directly to 보이다.
cc41586615bf6f07.zh: 「맛있는」是修飾名詞的冠形詞形，後面不能直接加 보이다。

cc41586615bf6f07.en: 맛있게 is an adverb; expressing look delicious requires -아/어 보이다.
cc41586615bf6f07.zh: 「맛있게」是副詞形，此處表示外觀看起來如何應使用 -아/어 보이다。

ccf8ffece26c702e.zh: 條件片語「날씨에 따라」置於句首，後接主詞「기분이」與謂語「달라져요」。
ccf8ffece26c702e.en: The phrase 날씨에 따라 sets the condition depending on the weather, followed by subject 기분이 and verb 달라져요.

cd095440f8a56e83.en: The stem 보다 has the bright vowel ㅗ, so it combines with -아야겠다 to form 봐야겠다.

cd095440f8a56e83.zh: 表達現在決定做某事應用「-겠다」，不應加上過去式「-었-」。
cd095440f8a56e83.en: The intention pattern uses -겠다 in the non-past; adding past tense -었- is incorrect.
보 and 아 must contract to 봐; 보야 is an incorrect spelling.

cd095440f8a56e83.zh: 詞幹加上過去式「-았-」再接「-어야겠다」是不合文法的錯誤組合。
cd095440f8a56e83.en: Adding the past tense -았- to the verb stem before -어야겠다 is grammatically incorrect.

cd4487983d2021b8.zh: 「-는 길이에요」表示正在前往…的途中，用「길 + 이에요」。
cd4487983d2021b8.en: 길이에요 combines the noun 길 with 이에요 to mean I am on my way.

cd4487983d2021b8.zh: 「길에요」是副詞形加上 요，結尾應用名詞句型的「이에요」。
cd4487983d2021b8.en: 길에요 uses the location particle 에 with 요, not the predicate ending 이에요.

cd4487983d2021b8.zh: 「길을요」接了受格助詞 을，文法錯誤且語意不通。
cd4487983d2021b8.en: 길을요 ends with the object particle 을 plus 요, which is grammatically incorrect here.

cd4487983d2021b8.zh: 「길했어요」不是韓語的自然用法，不存在此動詞組合。
cd4487983d2021b8.en: 길했어요 is an unnatural, non-existent verb formation in Korean.

cdf6eab05a5c025d.zh: 正確。「-던」表示剛才進行到一半、未完成就中斷的過去動作。
cdf6eab05a5c025d.en: Correct. 하던 expresses an interrupted or ongoing past action modifying 이야기.

cdf6eab05a5c025d.zh: 「하는」是現在式冠形詞詞尾，無法呼應前面的過去時間副詞「아까」。
cdf6eab05a5c025d.en: 하는 is the present-tense modifier, conflicting with the past time adverb 아까.

cdf6eab05a5c025d.zh: 「할」是未來式冠形詞詞尾，表示「將要說的話」，與語境不合。
cdf6eab05a5c025d.en: 할 is the future modifier for a story yet to be told.

cdf6eab05a5c025d.zh: 「한다」是終結詞尾，不能直接放在名詞「이야기」前面作為修飾語。
cdf6eab05a5c025d.en: 한다 is a sentence-ending form and cannot directly modify the noun 이야기.

cfad9ad85e6bc9c9.en: Correct. The noun modifier -는 attaches to 두다 before 게.
cfad9ad85e6bc9c9.zh: 修飾後方依存名詞「게（것이）」需要用現在式冠形詞詞尾「-는」。

cfad9ad85e6bc9c9.en: -고 connects clauses and cannot modify the noun 게.
-ㄴ다 is a plain style sentence ending, not a noun modifier.
cfad9ad85e6bc9c9.zh: 「-ㄴ다」為終結詞尾，後面不能直接接「게」。

cfad9ad85e6bc9c9.en: -는 게 좋다 is the standard idiomatic construction for giving recommendations.
cfad9ad85e6bc9c9.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」搭配「-게 좋다」不自然，建議事項通常使用現在形「-는 게 좋다」。

d23d0cb819371c8d.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ걸요」接在形容詞後表示推測，在此推測「應該沒有位子」。
d23d0cb819371c8d.en: -(으)ㄹ걸요 attaches to 없을 to express a guess, meaning there probably won't be a table.

d23d0cb819371c8d.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」只能用於第一人稱的承諾或動作，不能接在「없다」後。
d23d0cb819371c8d.en: -(으)ㄹ게요 conveys a speaker's promise and cannot attach to the adjective 없다.

d23d0cb819371c8d.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」表達說話者的意願，不能搭配「없다」表達推測。
d23d0cb819371c8d.en: -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses personal intention or willingness and cannot be used with 없다 here.

d23d0cb819371c8d.zh: 「-(으)ㅂ시다」是提議「我們一起做…」，不能用於「없다」。
d23d0cb819371c8d.en: -(으)ㅂ시다 is a suggestion meaning 'let us do', which cannot be used with 없다.

d34fb6d1ec849646.zh: 動詞「하다」無收音，現在式間接引述接「-ㄴ다고」，為「한다고」。
d34fb6d1ec849646.en: Action verbs ending in a vowel take -ㄴ다고 in indirect speech, so 한다고 is right.

d34fb6d1ec849646.zh: 「하다고」是形容詞的間接引述接法，動詞不可這樣用。
d34fb6d1ec849646.en: 하다고 applies to adjectives; action verbs require -ㄴ/는다고.

d34fb6d1ec849646.zh: 「-한라고」為混淆命令句引述與陳述句的錯誤形態。
d34fb6d1ec849646.en: -한라고 is a grammatically incorrect form that mixes imperative and declarative endings.

d34fb6d1ec849646.zh: 「-하냐고 하다」用於疑問句的間接引述，此處為陳述句。
d34fb6d1ec849646.en: -하냐고 is used for quoting questions, not declarative statements.

d37199ee39b120ce.zh: 「-지 않으면 안 되다」表示必須、非……不可，形成雙重否定。
d37199ee39b120ce.en: Correct. -지 않으면 안 되다 creates a double negative meaning 'must' or 'have to'.

d37199ee39b120ce.zh: 「받으면 안 돼요」意思完全相反，變成「拿到就不行／不可以領取」。
d37199ee39b120ce.en: 받으면 안 돼요 means 'you must not get', which reverses the intended requirement.

d37199ee39b120ce.zh: 「받지 않아도 안 돼요」語意矛盾且文法不通順。
d37199ee39b120ce.en: -아/어도 combined with 안 돼요 creates an ungrammatical, nonsensical contradiction.

d37199ee39b120ce.zh: 「안 받아도 안 돼요」同樣文法混亂，雙重否定否定詞尾應為 -지 않으면。
d37199ee39b120ce.en: This does not form the standard grammatical construction for expressing absolute necessity.

d39e46c5dfb0f9c2.zh: 修飾語「한국」接「친구를 사귀기 위해」表達交友目的，後接加入社團。
d39e46c5dfb0f9c2.en: 한국 modifies 친구를, which attaches to 사귀기 위해 to express purpose before joining the club.

d4b14b9b5294bfc8.zh: 處所「책상 위에」接被動定語「놓인」，修飾主語「책이 누구」。
d4b14b9b5294bfc8.en: 책상 위에 precedes the passive modifier 놓인, which modifies the subject 책이 before 누구.

d53bd08e418b1e12.zh: 條件句「지금 가면」修飾後項推測，副詞「벌써」置於謂語「끝났을걸요」前。
d53bd08e418b1e12.en: The conditional clause 지금 가면 precedes the adverb 벌써, which modifies the predicate guess 끝났을걸요.

d6654a477e2da9f6.zh: 主題「내일은」接原因「휴일이라서」，引出「은행이」與提醒語尾「쉬잖아요」。
d6654a477e2da9f6.en: Topic 내일은 leads into the reason 휴일이라서, followed by the subject 은행이 and ending 쉬잖아요.

d8d43409ecca2260.en: The passive form of 부르다 is 불리다, which conjugates politely to 불려요.

d8d43409ecca2260.zh: 「불러요」為主動形「唱」，但此句主詞是歌曲，需用被動「被唱」。
d8d43409ecca2260.en: 불러요 is active (sings); the passive form is needed since the subject is song.

d8d43409ecca2260.zh: 「부르다」的被動形式並非加上「-히-」，形態不正確。
d8d43409ecca2260.en: 부르다 does not take the suffix -히-; the correct passive form is 불리다.

d8d43409ecca2260.zh: 這不是韓語中存在的詞形，「부르다」的被動形是「불리다」。
d8d43409ecca2260.en: This is an incorrect form; the passive stem of 부르다 is 불리-.

d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 자다 attaches -아야겠다 to express an immediate decision: I should sleep.
d9b7a11f37288e1b.zh: 「자다」接「-아야겠다」表示當下的決定，意為「該睡了」。

d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 자야겠었어요 combines tense markers unnaturally and is grammatically incorrect.
d9b7a11f37288e1b.zh: 「자야겠었어요」時態重複疊加，是不正確的文法形態。

d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 잘 뻔했어요 means almost fell asleep, which does not fit deciding to sleep.
d9b7a11f37288e1b.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 뻔하다」表示差點發生某事，意為「差點睡著」。

d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 자기로 됐어요 means it has been arranged that I sleep, not a personal decision.
d9b7a11f37288e1b.zh: 「-기로 되다」表示客觀決定或安排，不符合個人的當下決心。

daef0afbfecf6153.en: Correct. The pattern -기는 하다 concedes a point before contrasting it.
daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 正確。「-기는 하다」表示承認事實但有轉折，接詞幹成「비싸기는」。

daef0afbfecf6153.en: The connective -는데 already means but and cannot precede 하지만.
daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 「-는데」本身就是轉折連接詞尾，後面不能再接「하지만」。

daef0afbfecf6153.en: The ending -거나 means or, which does not fit the pattern -기는 하다.
daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 「-거나」表示「或者」，與句型「-기는 하다」不合且文意不通。

daef0afbfecf6153.en: The ending -다가 indicates an interrupted action and cannot pair with 하지만.
daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中斷轉換，不能與「하지만」組合成轉折句型。

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: Correct. Action verbs take -는 in the present tense before 편이다.
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 正確。動詞現在式修飾名詞接「-는」，構成「먹는 편이다」。

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: The past modifier 먹은 indicates a completed event, not a habitual tendency.
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 「먹은」表示過去發生過，不適用於表示一般習慣傾向的「편이다」。

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: The future modifier 먹을 indicates conjecture, which does not fit general habits.
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 「먹을」表示未來或推測，不能用來描述日常的飲食習慣。

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: The conjugated form 먹어 cannot modify the dependent noun 편.
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 「먹어」是非敬語終結形，不能用來修飾後面的依託名詞「편」。

dd4cf1d6e16b38a4.zh: 條件句「지금 가면」在前，後接主謂「사람이 많을」修飾「텐데」。
dd4cf1d6e16b38a4.en: Condition 지금 가면 precedes subject 사람이 and adjective 많을, which attaches to 텐데.

ddcd83f1948e7cd8.zh: 受詞接原因 -느라고，後接另一受詞 숙제를 與否定結果 못 했어요。
ddcd83f1948e7cd8.en: Object 게임을 takes reason clause 하느라고, followed by object 숙제를 and negative predicate 못 했어요.

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 에 따라 attaches to nouns to mean depending on, perfectly fitting opinions differing by person.
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「에 따라」接在名詞後，表示「隨著、因人而異」，符合句意。

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 을 따라 means following along someone or a physical path, which does not fit here.
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「을 따라」是跟隨具體對象或沿著道路的意思，文法與語意不合。

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 에 비해 means compared to and indicates comparison rather than variation depending on the person.
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「에 비해」表示「與……相比」，是用來比較兩者，非因人而異。

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 대신 means instead of or in place of, which does not fit the context.
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「대신」表示「代替、反而」，與前後文的語意不符。

de79a1793c1c521d.en: 자마자 attaches to the stem 데뷔하- to mean became famous as soon as debuting.
de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 「자마자」接在詞幹데뷔하-後，表示一出道就變有名了。

de79a1793c1c521d.en: 다가 implies an action interrupted mid-way, which does not fit becoming famous after debuting.
de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 「다가」表示出道動作進行到一半中斷，不符合句意邏輯。

de79a1793c1c521d.en: With 는 동안, the sentence would say while debuting, rather than right after debut.
de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 題幹已有하，「는 동안」會變成데뷔하는 동안，表出道過程中。

de79a1793c1c521d.en: 거나 means or, expressing an alternative rather than immediate consequence.
de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 「거나」表示或者，表選擇關係，與出道後成名的先後因果不符。

de8f99ae48a1f414.zh: 主詞「우리 반 학생들은」接形容詞定語「조용한」修飾「편이에요」。
de8f99ae48a1f414.en: The subject 우리 반 학생들은 naturally precedes the modifying adjective 조용한, which attaches to 편이에요.

dea288f2ebd10213.zh: 主題「수업 시간에는」接賓語「휴대폰을」，再接輔助動詞「꺼 놓지 않으면 안 돼요」。
dea288f2ebd10213.en: Topic 수업 시간에는 takes object 휴대폰을, followed by compound verb 꺼 놓지 않으면 안 돼요.

df589e50eba448a0.en: Correct. -(으)ㄹ 텐데 provides context expressing a presupposition or regret.
df589e50eba448a0.zh: 正確。-(으)ㄹ 텐데 放在句中表示預期情況的轉折或背景說明。

df589e50eba448a0.en: 덕분에 means thanks to and does not follow the future-retrospective form.
df589e50eba448a0.zh: 「덕분에」表示「多虧……」，不能接在 -았/었을 之後。

df589e50eba448a0.en: 바람에 means as a result of (negative) and takes -는, not -(으)ㄹ.
df589e50eba448a0.zh: 「바람에」表示「因為（消極原因）」，通常接在動詞 -는 之後。

df589e50eba448a0.en: 동안 means during or while, which makes no sense in this context.
df589e50eba448a0.zh: 「동안」表示「期間」，接在 -(으)ㄹ 後語義不通。

e1553b9a0a225e3c.zh: 名詞後面直接加上「뿐만 아니라」，表示「不僅…而且…」。
e1553b9a0a225e3c.en: Attach 뿐만 아니라 directly to a noun to mean not only... but also...

e1553b9a0a225e3c.zh: 韓語中沒有「뿐만 아니고서」這種句型搭配。
e1553b9a0a225e3c.en: 뿐만 아니고서 is not an unnatural and non-standard grammatical form.

e1553b9a0a225e3c.zh: 名詞直接接「뿐만 아니라」，前面不需要加助詞「에」。
e1553b9a0a225e3c.en: Nouns connect directly to 뿐만 아니라 without the particle 에.

e1553b9a0a225e3c.zh: 名詞直接接「뿐만 아니라」，前面不需要加屬格助詞「의」。
e1553b9a0a225e3c.en: Nouns connect directly to 뿐만 아니라 without the possessive particle 의.

e31b0e8452bda976.zh: 時間副詞在前，修飾受詞 요리를，句尾接 -(으)ㄹ까 해요。
e31b0e8452bda976.en: Time adverb comes first, modifying the object 요리를, leading into the structure -(으)ㄹ까 해요.

e37347dee1dba35f.zh: 大主詞「이 방은」引導小主詞「창문이」，接形容詞冠詞形「작은」修飾「대신」。
e37347dee1dba35f.en: Topic 이 방은 leads into subject 창문이, followed by adjective modifier 작은 modifying 대신.

e3867259e02c93bf.zh: 賓語「한국어를」接讓步結構「배우기는 했지만」，後接副詞「잘」與「못해요」。
e3867259e02c93bf.en: Object 한국어를 precedes 배우기는 했지만, leading to adverb 잘 modifying 못해요.

e4822bef692cc4b8.en: Correct. The pattern -(으)ㄹ지도 pairs with 모르다 (몰라요) to mean might.
e4822bef692cc4b8.zh: 正確。-(으)ㄹ지도 固定搭配 모르다（몰라요）表示「可能……」。

e4822bef692cc4b8.en: 알아요 means to know and does not form this guessing grammar.
e4822bef692cc4b8.zh: 「알아요」表示知道，不可與 -(으)ㄹ지도 搭配表達可能推測。

e4822bef692cc4b8.en: 있어요 means exist/have and cannot follow -(으)ㄹ지도.
e4822bef692cc4b8.zh: 「있어요」表示存在或有，不能接在 -(으)ㄹ지도 後面。

e4822bef692cc4b8.en: 돼요 means to become or be okay and cannot follow -(으)ㄹ지도.

e58eda91637cc28f.zh: 地點「밖에」引出主謂「비가 오다」，動詞語幹接「-나 봐요」表示推測
e58eda91637cc28f.en: Location 밖에 precedes the clause 비가 오다, which takes -나 봐요 on verb 오다.

e659950ad14133eb.zh: 「에 따라」接在名詞後，表示「按照…、依照…」，符合句意。
e659950ad14133eb.en: 에 따라 attaches to a noun to mean in accordance with or following rules.

e659950ad14133eb.zh: 「에 비해」表示「比起…」，用於比較基準，不合句意。
e659950ad14133eb.en: 에 비해 means compared to, which does not make sense with acting according to rules.

e659950ad14133eb.zh: 「대신」表示「代替」或「作為補償」，不合句意。
e659950ad14133eb.en: 대신 means instead of, which would imply acting instead of rules.

e659950ad14133eb.zh: 「뿐만 아니라」表示「不僅…而且…」，語意在此不完整且不通順。
e659950ad14133eb.en: 뿐만 아니라 means not only, which leaves the sentence logically incomplete here.

e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: 하느라고 attaches to a verb stem to indicate that spending effort on doing something caused a negative result.
e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「하느라고」接動詞詞幹，表示因忙於某事而導致後面的負面結果。

e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: Past tense markers like -었/았- cannot attach before -느라고, so 했느라고 is ungrammatical.
e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「-느라고」前不可加過去式標記「-었/았-」，此形態錯誤。

e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: 하려고 expresses an intention or purpose (in order to do) rather than explaining a negative consequence.
e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「하려고」表示意圖「為了做」，無法接續後方的消極結果。

e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: 하도록 means so that or to the extent that, which does not fit giving an excuse for a negative outcome.
e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「하도록」表示目的或使動「為了讓…」，語意在此不通順。

e767ba44ba2e44a4.en: -지 않도록 is the standard negative form meaning so as not to or in order not to.
e767ba44ba2e44a4.zh: 否定形「-지 않다」接「-도록」形成「-지 않도록」，意為「為了不…」。
韓語中無「-게도록」這種雙重副詞形接尾的文法形式。

e767ba44ba2e44a4.en: 말다 is used in prohibitions like -지 마세요, not as a standard subordinate clause here.
e767ba44ba2e44a4.zh: 「말다」用於禁止命令句，在一般修飾副詞子句中應使用「않다」。

e767ba44ba2e44a4.en: 못하다 expresses inability; ordinary negative prevention with 조심하세요 uses 않도록.
e767ba44ba2e44a4.zh: 「못하다」表示能力不足，與「조심하다」搭配常規否定應用「않다」。

e8c445a6bc82d83d.zh: 「먹다」有收音，必須加上媒介音接「-으려면」表示「若想要吃」。
e8c445a6bc82d83d.en: 먹다 has a final consonant, requiring 으 to correctly form 먹으려면.
먹려면 is incorrect because stems with a final consonant require the buffer 으.

e8c445a6bc82d83d.zh: 韓語中沒有「-러면」這種條件接續語尾形態。
e8c445a6bc82d83d.en: 먹으러면 is an incorrect form; the conditional ending is -(으)려면.

e8c445a6bc82d83d.zh: 「-려고」表示打算，後方接「예약해야 해요」需要用條件句「-려면」。
e8c445a6bc82d83d.en: 먹으려고 indicates an intention, but establishing a required condition needs -(으)려면.

e92e29ddd32d6277.en: The stem 오- combines with -아도 to contract into 와도, meaning even if it rains.
오- and -아도 must contract into 와; 오아도 is not used.
The concessive ending requires -아/어도; 오도 lacks the connecting vowel 아.
e92e29ddd32d6277.zh: 讓步句型需接「-아/어도」，「오도」缺少連接元音아。

e92e29ddd32d6277.en: 오면 means if it rains, expressing a condition rather than concession.
e92e29ddd32d6277.zh: 「-(으)면」表假設「如果下雨」，無法表達即使下雨之讓步感。

eab18a1ed1a5801f.zh: 受詞「살을」接動詞短語「빼기 위해서」表減肥目的，再接「저녁을」受詞。
eab18a1ed1a5801f.en: 살을 links to 빼기 위해서 to state the purpose of losing weight, followed by 저녁을 for dinner.

eb374da39db4b9ed.en: The noun 밥 attaches directly to 대신 to mean instead of rice.
eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 名詞「밥」後直接加「대신(에)」，表示「代替米飯」。

eb374da39db4b9ed.en: Korean nouns attach directly to 대신 without the possessive marker 의.
eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 韓語名詞接「대신」時直接相連，不習慣加上所有格助詞「의」。

eb374da39db4b9ed.en: -는 대신 is used with verb stems, not directly after nouns like 밥.
eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 「-는 대신」用於動詞詞幹之後，名詞「밥」後不可接「는」。

eb374da39db4b9ed.en: 대로 means in accordance with or as, which does not mean instead of.
eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 「대로」接在名詞後表示「按照…」，不符合吃麵包代替飯的語意。

eb4372922e99f1c1.en: 하다 combines with -아야/어야겠다 to become 해야겠어요 (I should do).
하야겠어요 is an incorrect conjugation of 하다 with -아야/어야겠다.
해야겠었요 is a misspelling and grammatically malformed ending.
eb4372922e99f1c1.zh: 「해야겠었요」拼寫與時態形態錯誤，正確結尾為「-어요」。

eb4372922e99f1c1.en: 하겠어야요 has an incorrect order of endings and is ungrammatical.
eb4372922e99f1c1.zh: 「하겠어야요」語尾接續順序完全錯誤，沒有這種文法結構。

ec25edf5f7609300.en: Correct. The adjective 크다 ends in a vowel, so it takes -ㄴ to become 큰 편이에요.
ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 正確。形容詞「크다」無終聲尾音，修飾名詞接「-ㄴ 편이다」。

ec25edf5f7609300.en: When describing height, 크다 is an adjective and cannot take -는.
ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 「크다」在此為形容詞表示個子高，修飾名詞不可接「-는」。

ec25edf5f7609300.en: The prospective form 클 implies future or conjecture, not current height.
ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 「클」表示未來或推測，不能用來描述目前的身高特徵。

ec25edf5f7609300.en: The informal ending 커 cannot be used as a modifier before 편.
ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 「커」是非敬語口語終結形，無法直接修飾名詞「편」。

ee1fe2997dee6a46.zh: 「나이에」接「비해」表比較基準，後面接主語「키가」與形容詞「커요」。
ee1fe2997dee6a46.en: 나이에 connects to 비해 for compared to age, followed by subject 키가 and predicate 커요.

ee49dc6639f90860.en: The teacher is commanding homework submission; reported commands casually shorten to -(으)래요.
ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 老師要求交作業是命令句，口語轉述縮略形用「-(으)래요」，故選「내래요」。

ee49dc6639f90860.en: 낸대요 reports a statement (says they submit), not an instruction to students.
ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 「낸대요」是陳述句轉述（-ㄴ다고 해요），意思會變成老師說他自己要交作業。

ee49dc6639f90860.en: 내재요 reports a suggestion (short for -자고 해요, let's submit), not a teacher's directive.
ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 「내재요」是提議句轉述縮略形（-자고 해요），意思是提議「一起交吧」。

ee49dc6639f90860.en: 내냬요 reports a question (short for -냐고 해요, asks if you submit), not a command.
ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 「내냬요」是疑問句轉述縮略形（-냐고 해요），意思是詢問「要不要交」。

eec83a09f38bf623.en: 말했잖아요 uses past tense to remind the listener of what you told them yesterday.
eec83a09f38bf623.zh: 「말했잖아요」是過去式，提醒對方「我昨天不是說過了嗎？」。

eec83a09f38bf623.en: 말하잖아요 is present tense, which clashes with 어제 (yesterday).
eec83a09f38bf623.zh: 「말하잖아요」是現在式，與表示昨天的「어제」時態不符。
「말할잖아요」是不合文法的錯誤形態，將來式不可這樣接續。

eec83a09f38bf623.en: 말하자고요 means let's say or quotes a proposal, unfitting here.
eec83a09f38bf623.zh: 「말하자고요」表示引用「我們說好要說」，文意不符。

f0a2cc124a3ff41e.zh: 「-을까 하다」為固定句型，此處現在式應填入「해요」。
f0a2cc124a3ff41e.en: -(으)ㄹ까 하다 is the set pattern for considering an action, so 해요 is correct.

f0a2cc124a3ff41e.zh: 「돼요」無法與「-을까」搭配構成考慮做某事的文法。
f0a2cc124a3ff41e.en: 돼요 does not pair with -(으)ㄹ까 to express vague plans.

f0a2cc124a3ff41e.zh: 「있어요」不能與「-을까」組合，沒有「-을까 있다」的句型。
f0a2cc124a3ff41e.en: 있어요 does not attach to -(으)ㄹ까 to denote an intention.

f0a2cc124a3ff41e.zh: 「줘요」表示給予，不能與「-을까」搭配形成打算做某事的句型。
f0a2cc124a3ff41e.en: 줘요 means to give and cannot form the intention construction with -(으)ㄹ까.

f16f4961554ec5af.en: Correct. It contrasts past action with the result using the past connective 했는데.
f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 正確。前後語意轉折，且後句為過去未完成，故選過去轉折形「했는데」。

f16f4961554ec5af.en: The sentence-ending form 하는데요 cannot connect two clauses within a sentence.
f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 「하는데요」是句子終結敬語形式，不能放在句中連接下文。

f16f4961554ec5af.en: The conditional 했으면 means if I did, which contradicts the contrasting context.
f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 「했으면」表示假設「如果做了的話」，不符合後句轉折的語境。

f16f4961554ec5af.en: The intention suffix 하려고 means in order to do, which does not make sense here.
f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 「하려고」表示意圖「打算做」，與後句「沒能全部做完」無法搭配。

f1e3905b3c96a540.zh: 時間詞「어제」修飾定語「본」，構成主語「어제 본 영화가」，後接感受「재미있더라고요」。
f1e3905b3c96a540.en: Time word 어제 modifies the relative clause 본 to form the subject 어제 본 영화가, ending with 재미있더라고요.

f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋다 has a final consonant, so it correctly takes -을 뿐만 아니라.
f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋다」是形容詞詞幹，有收音接「-을 뿐만 아니라」。

f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋은 is the standard modifier for adjectives, but this pattern requires -(으)ㄹ.
f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋은」是一般形容詞冠形詞形，但該句型固定要求接「-(으)ㄹ」。

f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋는 is ungrammatical; adjectives cannot take the verb modifier suffix -는.
f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋는」文法錯誤，形容詞不能接動詞冠形詞尾「-는」。

f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋아 is an informal ending and cannot grammatically connect to 뿐.
f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋아」是口語終結詞尾，不能直接接名詞「뿐」。

f2797560e083d1a6.zh: 時間「아침에」接「일어나자마자」，再接受詞「물을」與動詞「마셔요」。
f2797560e083d1a6.en: 아침에 sets the time for 일어나자마자, which is followed by the object 물을 and the verb 마셔요.

f4fcbb1c88b28667.zh: 「-았다가」表示先完成了開燈動作，隨後做出相反行為（又關掉）。
f4fcbb1c88b28667.en: 켰다가 correctly expresses completing the action of turning on the light, followed by reversing it.

f4fcbb1c88b28667.zh: 「켜다가」表示開燈的動作進行中途中斷，而非開好後又關掉。
f4fcbb1c88b28667.en: 켜다가 means the action was interrupted in the middle of turning the light on, not after it was on.

f4fcbb1c88b28667.zh: 「-면서」表示邊開燈邊做另一件事，無法表達因太亮又關掉。
f4fcbb1c88b28667.en: 켜면서 indicates doing two actions simultaneously, which does not make sense here.

f4fcbb1c88b28667.zh: 「-려고」表示打算開燈的意圖，無法連接後面的太亮而關掉。
f4fcbb1c88b28667.en: 켜려고 expresses the intention in order to turn on, which does not fit the causal sequence.

f5431fbf13657820.zh: 時間副詞「오늘은」接「일찍」，再接目的地「집에」與謂語。
f5431fbf13657820.en: The topic adverbial 오늘은 comes first, followed by adverb 일찍, destination 집에, and verb 들어가야겠어요.

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: Correct. The adjective 조용하다 ends in a vowel and takes -ㄴ to modify 편.
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 正確。形容詞「조용하다」以母音結尾，接「-ㄴ 편이다」。

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: Adjectives do not take the present modifier -는; 조용하는 is ungrammatical.
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 「조용하다」是形容詞，修飾名詞時不可接動詞專用的「-는」。

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: The future modifier 조용할 expresses supposition, not a general tendency.
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 「조용할」表示未來推測，不能用來客觀描述社區平時的特點。

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: The conjugated form 조용해 cannot directly modify the noun 편.
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 「조용해」是句子結尾的非敬語形式，不能直接修飾名詞「편」。

f688188613555f2e.zh: 地點「집에」接「도착하자마자」表示一到家，接受詞「샤워를」與「했어요」。
f688188613555f2e.en: 집에 leads into 도착하자마자 to indicate the immediate timing, followed by the object 샤워를 and verb 했어요.

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: 보느라 is the shortened form of 보느라고, correctly expressing that watching drama caused failing to do homework.
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「보느라」是「보느라고」的縮略形，表示因追劇而沒能做作業。

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: Past tense markers cannot precede -느라(고), making 봤느라 grammatically incorrect.
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「-느라(고)」前不能加過去式標記「-었/았-」，形態錯誤。

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: 보러 means in order to see and must be followed by movement verbs like 가다 or 오다.
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「보러」表示移動的目的「去看」，通常搭配「가다/오다」。

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: 보려면 means if you intend to watch, which sets up a condition rather than explaining an excuse.
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「보려면」表示假設意圖「如果想要看的話」，語意不符。

fa9f140ee40fb8e6.zh: 時間「어제」接賓語「잠을」，副詞「못」置於動詞前修飾「잤거든요」。
fa9f140ee40fb8e6.en: Time 어제 precedes object 잠을, followed by the negative adverb 못 modifying 잤거든요.

fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: Correct. -다가 attaches directly to the basic stem 걷- without ㄷ irregular change.
fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 正確。「-다가」直接接原形詞幹「걷-」，表示走路途中跌倒。

fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: 걸다가 mistakenly applies the ㄷ irregular change before the consonant -다가.
fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 「걸다가」錯誤將「걷다」變音，接輔音開頭的「-다가」不變音。

fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: 걸었다가 implies finishing the walk before falling, losing the sense of falling mid-action.
fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 「걸었다가」強調走完後才跌倒，無法表達「走路進行中跌倒」。

fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: 걸으러 expresses purpose ('in order to walk'), which does not fit.
fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 「걸으러」表示「為了去散步/走路」，表示目的，與句意不符。

fba7fc333c5c6dc4.zh: 主語「비가」後接動詞「올 뿐만 아니라」，再接後續並列主語「바람도」。
fba7fc333c5c6dc4.en: Subject 비가 connects to 올 뿐만 아니라, followed by the second subject 바람도.

fe9c052f75ae4162.en: Correct. For a guess about a past event, use -았/었을지도 몰라요.
fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 正確。表示對過去已發生事情的推測，使用 -았/었을지도 몰라요。

fe9c052f75ae4162.en: 떠날지도는 has an unnecessary topic marker 는 and is not past tense.
fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 「떠날지도는」後面多接了助詞 는，且為未來式，與 벌써 不合。

fe9c052f75ae4162.en: 떠나을지도 is an ungrammatical spelling; past stems require -았/었-.
fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 「떠나을지도」拼寫錯誤，無收音詞幹過去式應為 떠났-。

fe9c052f75ae4162.en: 떠난지도 indicates time elapsed since leaving, not uncertain possibility.
fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 「떠난지도」表示自從離開之後的時間，無法搭配 몰라요 表示可能。
